https://leadership.ng/nigeria-proposes-l.title_zh: 尼日利亚提议打通西非10国债券市场
https://leadership.ng/nigeria-proposes-l.body_zh: 财政部长兼经济协调部长Taiwo Oyedele于周二在拉各斯举行的S&P Global Ratings Africa Summit上披露了这一情况。他表示，该地区资本市场分散，限制了获取支持经济发展所需大规模融资的渠道。Oyedele称，该地区没有任何单一市场拥有足够深度，无法吸引为基础设施融资和推动可持续增长所需的大规模长期投资，因此各国加强合作势在必行。根据拟议框架，尼日利亚正主张建立区域性资本市场护照制度，允许在一个参与国获批的发行人无须分别经过监管审批程序，即可在其他市场筹集资金。该提案还包括建立统一的投资者识别系统，使在一个市场登记的投资者无须重复履行登记和准入要求，便可在整个地区购买债券和股票。部长表示，尼日利亚同样推动整合区域性交易、结算和支付基础设施，使证券交易能够直接以当地货币结算，从而降低对美国美元的依赖。拟议的整合范围将涵盖尼日利亚、加纳以及共享CFA法郎并拥有共同中央银行的8个法语国家，即贝宁、布基纳法索、科特迪瓦、几内亚比绍、马里、尼日尔、塞内加尔和多哥。Oyedele表示，包括西非资本市场整合委员会、非洲交易所互联互通项目以及泛非支付与结算系统（PAPSS）在内的现有区域倡议，为拟议整合奠定了基础。他说：“现在的任务是把这些环节连接起来。”除消除监管和运营障碍外，拟议改革还将包括开发区域本币债券指数，以及设立信用增级机制，以支持跨境基础设施融资。信用增级机制预计将增强各国吸引长期资本的能力，支持那些可能难以从单个国内市场获得资金的项目。Oyedele表示，更广泛的目标是打造更具整合度的投资环境，在吸引国内外投资者的同时，改善整个地区的资本获取渠道。他还披露，尼日利亚正以三年内获得投资级信用评级为目标，作为增强投资者信心和改善该国获取国际资本渠道努力的一部分。部长表示，政府正依据其十年资本市场计划，努力建设价值至少$1 trillion的资本市场。拟议的区域整合预计将把投资机会拓展至国界之外，使发行人能够接触更广泛的投资者群体，并为投资者在西非各地配置资本提供更多机会。我们掌握最新动态。获取实时报道、独家内幕和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp频道，随时获取24/7最新消息 → 加入我们的WhatsApp频道 --> --> Bukola Aro-Lambo Bukola Aro-Lambo是Leadership Newspaper记者，拥有十余年经验，专长于经济和金融报道。她以严谨、数据驱动的方法，将官方数据与专家洞见相结合，报道宏观经济趋势、财政政策、公共财政、银行和金融科技领域。她的报道还涉及发展融资、基础设施资金、农业出口、气候融资和科技驱动的企业，提供清晰且具有分析性的报道，帮助公众就尼日利亚不断演变的经济格局展开知情讨论。

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title: India rejects Khalistani separatist Pannun's US lawsuit as ‘fabricated, malicious attack'
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary: India on Tuesday rejected the case filed by Khalistani separatist Gurpatwant Singh Pannun in the US against National Security Adviser Ajit Doval and the government, describing such moves as “fabricated and malicious attacks” that will not stand the test of legal processes. At the same time, the Indian side has officially taken up the “frivolous nature” of Pannun’s lawsuit with US authorities, people familiar with the matter said on condition of anonymity.
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 印度周二驳回了旁遮普分离主义分子古尔帕特万特·辛格·潘努恩在美国针对国家安全顾问阿吉特·多瓦尔和印度政府提起的诉讼，称此类举动是“捏造且恶意的攻击”，经不起法律程序的考验。与此同时，知情人士在匿名条件下表示，印度方面已正式向美国当局指出潘努恩诉讼“轻率”的性质。
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: India on Tuesday rejected the case filed by Khalistani separatist Gurpatwant Singh Pannun in the US against National Security Adviser Ajit Doval and the government, describing such moves as “fabricated and malicious attacks” that will not stand the test of legal processes. At the same time, the Indian side has officially taken up the “frivolous nature” of Pannun’s lawsuit with US authorities, people familiar with the matter said on condition of anonymity. The people noted that the NSA enjoys diplomatic immunity and said the legal moves by Pannun are aimed at keeping the Khalistan issue in the limelight and have no legal merit, they said. External affairs ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal dismissed the case filed by Pannun when he was asked about the matter at a regular media briefing. He also made it clear that all official communications related to the issue will have to be routed through India’s law ministry. “We reject the fabricated and malicious attacks on our high officials, as also we reject the frivolous lawsuits,” he said. “Requests for serving of judicial documents in India can only be routed through India’s designated central authority, that is the ministry of law and justice.” The two developments mark separate steps in the process of formally notifying the defendants in the civil suit, which alleges that Indian officials conspired to assassinate Pannun at his New York home in 2023. However, neither amounts to a judicial finding on the allegations, and the latest court order does not establish any liability on the part of the Indian government or the two officials. In a letter to the US District Court for the Southern District of New York dated October 20, the state department stated that it transmitted the summons, complaint and notice of suit to the Indian embassy under cover of a diplomatic note signed on September 30 and delivered on October 9. Also Read | No bail for two linked to Khalistan terror module The department said the transmission was undertaken in discharge of its statutory responsibilities under the US Foreign Sovereign Immunities Act (FSIA), while making clear it was not taking any position on the merits of the case or whether all legal requirements for service had been fulfilled. The people cited above said this was not the proper procedure for serving such documents. They also noted that such matters come under the purview of The Hague Convention, especially the Service Convention of 1965 that governs the cross-border service of judicial documents. India has for long taken up the activities of Pannun and other Khalistani separatists based in North America with the US side, including the threats issued by them against Indian diplomats and missions. The Indian side has also informed the US side of the frivolous nature of legal cases filed by the separatists. The diplomatic note from the US asked the Indian government to forward the documents to the appropriate authority and take steps to avoid a default judgment. It referred to a 60-day period within which a defendant is required to file an answer or other responsive pleading, warning that failure could expose it to a judgment without an opportunity to present its arguments or evidence. The state department’s transmission, however, should not be read as an endorsement of Pannun’s allegations or as a determination of the Indian government’s liability. The department expressly clarified its action didn’t reflect a position on whether service had been properly effected, the status or character of the defendants, or the merits of the claims and possible defences. Separately, in an order dated November 9, US district judge Katherine Polk Failla allowed Pannun to send summonses for Doval and Goel to designated district courts in Delhi, which would be requested to serve them as if they were summonses issued by Indian courts. The ruling followed Pannun’s difficulties in serving Doval personally during his visits to the US. According to court filings, he made three attempts to serve the summons to the NSA, but security personnel prevented process servers from doing so. Pannun claimed his attempts to route the documents through India’s law ministry, also failed. The law ministry returned the documents with a brief communication stating that the summons did not fall within relevant categories. Pannun argued this amounted to India’s determination that the Hague Convention didn’t apply, freeing him to seek alternative methods of service. The US judge rejected this contention and said the Indian authority’s response was too ambiguous to establish it had made a legal determination on The Hague Convention’s applicability. Instead, the court held that the Hague Convention applied to civil proceedings but permitted service through Indian courts under Article 19, which preserves domestic legal procedures allowing more permissive methods of transmitting foreign judicial documents. The judge relied on Section 29(c) of India’s Code of Civil Procedure, which allows summonses issued by notified foreign civil courts to be sent to Indian courts and served as if they had been issued by those courts. A January 12, 2009 government notification extended this provision to civil courts in countries party to the Hague Convention. However, the US court left open the possibility of revisiting this conclusion if the Indian government or an Indian court expresses a contrary view. The judge identified Patiala House, Dwarka and Tis Hazari court complexes in Delhi as possible receiving courts and held that summonses can be mailed to them for service on Doval and Goel. The process, however, is not complete. Pannun has been directed to submit by November 30 a proposed packet containing the summonses, a draft order detailing the proposed procedure, relevant Indian legal provisions and the documents returned by India’s law ministry. Only after examining and approving these materials will the US court direct its clerk to transmit the packet to the designated Indian courts. The November 9 order is confined to Doval and Goel. It does not grant the same relief to other defendants, including the Indian government, former RAW officer Vikash Yadav and Nikhil Gupta. Nor does it determine whether the US court has jurisdiction to adjudicate the substantive claims or what defences, including any immunity-related objections, may be available to the defendants. Pannun, who has been designated a terrorist by India, filed the civil suit in 2024 against the Indian government and several individuals, seeking to hold them liable for an alleged conspiracy to kill him. India has denied state involvement in the alleged plot. The civil proceedings run parallel to a criminal prosecution in the US arising from the alleged murder-for-hire conspiracy. US prosecutors have accused Nikhil Gupta of working with Vikash Yadav to arrange Pannun’s assassination. Gupta pleaded guilty in February. Doval and Goel have not been charged in that criminal case
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: 印度谴责旁努恩在美诉讼，称其为“捏造且怀有恶意的攻击”
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 印度周二驳回了旁遮普分离主义分子古尔帕特万特·辛格·潘嫩在美国针对印度国家安全顾问阿吉特·多瓦尔和印度政府提起的诉讼，称此类举动是“捏造且恶毒的攻击”，经不起法律程序的考验。与此同时，据知情人士透露，在不公开姓名的情况下，印度方面已正式向美国当局指出潘嫩诉讼“轻率无据”的性质。知情人士称，国家安全顾问享有外交豁免权，潘嫩采取的法律行动旨在让旁遮普问题持续受到关注，不具备任何法律依据。在例行媒体吹风会上被问及此事时，印度外交部发言人兰迪尔·贾伊瓦尔否定了潘嫩提起的案件。他还明确表示，与该问题有关的所有官方通信都必须通过印度法律部转交。他说：“我们驳斥针对我方高级官员的捏造且恶毒的攻击，也驳斥这些轻率无据的诉讼。”他表示：“在印度境内送达司法文书，只能通过印度指定的中央主管机关，即法律与司法部转交。”这两项进展分别属于正式通知该民事诉讼被告程序的独立步骤。该诉讼指控印度官员于2023年阴谋在潘嫩位于纽约的住所将其暗杀。不过，两者均不构成法院对相关指控的司法认定，最新法院命令也未认定印度政府或这两名官员承担任何责任。国务院在10月20日致纽约南区美国联邦地区法院的一封信中表示，已通过一份9月30日签署、10月9日送达的外交照会，将传票、起诉书及诉讼通知转交印度大使馆。相关阅读｜两名与旁遮普恐怖组织有关人员不准保释。该部门表示，转交这些文件是为履行美国《外国主权豁免法》（FSIA）规定的法定职责，同时明确说明其不对案件是非曲直或所有送达法律要求是否均已得到满足表明立场。上述知情人士称，这并非送达此类文件的适当程序。他们还指出，此类事项属于《海牙公约》的管辖范围，尤其是规范跨境送达司法文件的1965年《送达公约》。长期以来，印度一直就潘嫩及其他旅居北美的旁遮普分离主义分子的活动与美方交涉，包括他们针对印度外交官和使团发出的威胁。印度方面也已向美方说明这些分离主义分子提起的法律案件轻率无据。美国外交照会要求印度政府将文件转交适当机关，并采取措施避免因缺席而作出缺席判决。照会提及60天的期限，被告须在此期间提交答辩状或其他回应性诉状，并警告若未按要求提交，可能在无法陈述其主张或提交证据的情况下被判决。不过，不应将国务院的转交行为解读为认可潘嫩的指控，或认定印度政府承担责任。该部门明确澄清，其行动不表示对是否已妥善完成送达、被告的身份或性质，以及索赔的实体内容和可能提出的抗辩采取任何立场。另据一项日期为11月9日的命令，美国地区法官凯瑟琳·波尔克·法伊拉准许潘嫩向德里的指定地区法院发送针对多瓦尔和戈尔的传票，并请求这些法院按印度法院签发的传票予以送达。该裁定源于潘嫩在多瓦尔访问美国期间难以向其本人送达传票的问题。根据法院文件，他曾三次尝试向国家安全顾问送达传票，但安保人员阻止送达员执行送达。潘嫩声称，他通过印度法律部转交文件的尝试也告失败。法律部将文件退回，并附上一份简短说明，称传票不属于相关类别。潘嫩认为，这等于印度认定《海牙公约》不适用，从而使他可以寻求其他送达方式。美国法官驳回了这一主张，称印度主管部门的回复过于含糊，无法证明其已就《海牙公约》的适用性作出法律认定。法院反而认定，《海牙公约》适用于民事诉讼，但允许依据第19条通过印度法院完成送达；该条保留了国内法律程序，允许采用更为宽松的方式传递外国司法文件。法官援引了印度《民事诉讼法》第29(c)条。该条允许将经通知的外国民事法院签发的传票送交印度法院，并视同由这些法院签发的传票予以送达。2009年1月12日的一项政府通知将这一规定扩大适用于加入《海牙公约》国家的民事法院。不过，美国法院保留了重新审议这一结论的可能性。如果印度政府或印度法院持相反观点，法院可再次审查该问题。法官将德里的帕蒂亚拉宫、德瓦卡和蒂斯哈扎里法院综合体列为可能的接收法院，并认定传票可邮寄至这些法院，用于向多瓦尔和戈尔送达。不过，整个程序尚未完成。潘嫩已被要求在11月30日前提交一套拟议材料，其中包括传票、详细说明拟议程序的命令草案、相关印度法律规定，以及印度法律部退回的文件。美国法院审查并批准这些材料后，才会指示书记员将材料转交给指定的印度法院。11月9日的命令仅涉及多瓦尔和戈尔，并未给予其他被告同样的救济，包括印度政府、前印度调查局官员维卡什·亚达夫和尼基尔·古普塔。该命令也未裁定美国法院是否对审理实体索赔具有管辖权，也未确定被告可提出哪些抗辩，包括与豁免权有关的异议。潘嫩已被印度认定为恐怖分子。他于2024年针对印度政府和数名个人提起该民事诉讼，要求追究他们据称参与杀害他的阴谋责任。印度否认政府参与上述阴谋。该民事诉讼与美国的刑事诉讼同步进行，后者源于据称存在的付费谋杀阴谋。美国检方指控尼基尔·古普塔与维卡什·亚达夫合作安排潘嫩遇刺。古普塔于2月认罪。多瓦尔和戈尔尚未在这起刑事案件中被起诉

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The Korean Army has temporarily grounded its Apache military helicopters as U.S. authorities began inspections on the fleet over a possible malfunction of their transmission system, an Army official said Tuesday. The grounding of the AH-64E Apache Guardian attack helicopters has been in place since early October, after the Army received a safety advisory from the U.S. military regarding the transmission component, Army spokesperson Capt. Bae Seok-jin said in a press briefing. "As a safety precaution, the Army temporarily grounded the fleet in early October (for the U.S. side) to conduct technical inspections in phases," Bae said. "Operations will resume sequentially based on the inspection results." While routine training flights are paused during the grounding, the helicopters usually stand ready for an immediate operational launch in the event of a contingency. "There are currently no issues with our readiness or operational posture," the Army spokesperson added. Manufactured by Boeing, the Apache helicopters serve as a key asset for air-to-ground defense for the Korean military, which currently operates a fleet of 36 units. The U.S. Army issued a statement early last month on the temporary pause of flight operations for Apache helicopters, citing technical assessments of their transmission systems. The inspections follow an August crash of an Apache helicopter in Texas that killed two U.S. soldiers. The same model also went down during a patrol operation near the Strait of Hormuz in June for reasons that have not been identified. Other countries operating the Apache chopper appear to be taking the same step. Taiwan also grounded the helicopters last month, local media have reported
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 美国检查疑似缺陷期间，军方暂时停飞阿帕奇直升机
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国陆军已临时停飞其阿帕奇军用直升机；美国当局开始检查该机队，原因是其 transmission system 可能存在故障。陆军官员周二表示。陆军发言人 Bae Seok-jin 上尉在新闻发布会上说，自10月初起，AH-64E“阿帕奇守卫者”攻击直升机便处于停飞状态，此前陆军收到了美国军方就 transmission 部件发布的安全警示。Bae说：“作为安全预防措施，陆军于10月初临时停飞该机队，以便美方分阶段进行技术检查。各项行动将根据检查结果依次恢复。”停飞期间，例行训练飞行暂停，但这些直升机通常仍随时待命，一旦发生突发情况即可立即投入行动。陆军发言人补充说：“我们目前的战备状态和作战部署没有问题。”这些阿帕奇直升机由波音制造，是韩国军队实施对地防御的重要装备；韩国目前运营一支由36架该型直升机组成的机队。美国陆军上月早些时候曾就阿帕奇直升机暂停飞行行动发表声明，称其依据是对 transmission systems 的技术评估。此次检查是在8月得克萨斯州发生一架阿帕奇直升机坠毁事故后进行的，事故造成两名美军士兵死亡。同款直升机6月也在霍尔木兹海峡附近执行巡逻任务时坠毁，原因尚未查明。据当地媒体报道，其他运营阿帕奇直升机的国家似乎也在采取同样措施。台湾上月也让这些直升机停飞。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: The share of Korea's top 10 exporters in the country's total outbound shipments rose sharply in the third quarter from a year earlier, data showed Tuesday, driven by strong demand for semiconductors and other technology products. Exports by the top 10 companies accounted for 60.9 percent of total exports in the July-September period, up from 40.5 percent a year earlier, according to data compiled by the Ministry of Data and Statistics. The country's top 100 exporters accounted for 79.4 percent of total exports in the third quarter, up from 67.9 percent a year earlier. Korea's total exports came to $318.6 billion in the third quarter, an increase of 72.3 percent on-year. By company size, exports by conglomerates more than doubled to $248.6 billion, while those by medium-sized companies rose 12.8 percent to $36.9 billion. Exports by small enterprises also gained a solid 10.7 percent to $32.7 billion. By industry, exports by the mining and manufacturing sector surged 82.8 percent to $291.5 billion. Within the sector, the electronics industry, including chips, saw its exports soar 143.6 percent to $206 billion. Exports by the wholesale and retail sector rose 5.1 percent to $20 billion

https://www.myjoyonline.com/womens-devel.body: The proposed Women's Development Bank has submitted an application to the Bank of Ghana (BoG) for a banking licence, marking a major step towards its establishment. Vice President Professor Jane Naana Opoku-Agyemang says a dedicated committee tasked with developing the institution has completed its work and submitted the application through the Ministry of Finance for regulatory consideration. Speaking at the 15th Ghana Economic Forum organised by the B&FT, she said the bank is being designed to address persistent financing challenges confronting women-owned businesses, particularly those operating in the informal sector. She explained that the institution will adopt a different approach from conventional banks by bringing financial services closer to women entrepreneurs and traders. "We therefore constituted a dedicated committee that brought together market women, susu collectors, representatives of women's business associations, financial sector professionals and other key stakeholders," she said. The Vice President noted that the committee's work was guided by the need to ensure that the bank reflects the actual experiences and financial needs of women. "My conviction has always been that an institution established to serve women must be shaped by the experiences, aspirations and everyday realities of those very women," she added. Professor Opoku-Agyemang cited Ghana Statistical Service data indicating that women manage nearly 60 per cent of micro-establishments but account for less than 10 per cent of large businesses. She said the disparity highlights the need for targeted financial interventions to help women-owned enterprises expand and become more competitive. "This bank is not meant to be just another financial institution. It is conceived as a last-mile bank designed to bring financial services closer to the women whose enterprise and hard work sustain our markets and local economies," she stated
https://www.myjoyonline.com/womens-devel.title_zh: 妇女发展银行向尼日利亚中央银行申请银行牌照
https://www.myjoyonline.com/womens-devel.body_zh: 拟议中的妇女开发银行已向加纳银行（BoG）提交银行业牌照申请，标志着该行筹建取得重要进展。副总统简·娜娜·奥波库-阿吉芒教授表示，负责筹建该机构的专门委员会已完成工作，并通过财政部提交申请，交由监管机构审议。她在B&FT组织的第15届加纳经济论坛上说，该银行旨在解决女性拥有的企业，尤其是非正规部门企业，长期面临的融资困难。她解释说，该机构将采取有别于传统银行的模式，让金融服务更贴近女性创业者和商人。她说：“因此，我们组建了一个专门委员会，汇聚了市场妇女、susu收款人、女性商业协会代表、金融行业专业人士及其他关键利益相关方。”副总统指出，委员会开展工作的指导原则，是确保该银行反映女性的真实经历和金融需求。她补充道：“我一直坚信，一个为女性服务的机构，必须依据这些女性自身的经历、抱负和日常生活来塑造。”奥波库-阿吉芒教授援引加纳统计局的数据指出，女性经营着近60%的微型企业，但在大型企业中所占比例不足10%。她说，这一差距凸显了有必要采取有针对性的金融干预措施，帮助女性拥有的企业扩大规模并提升竞争力。她表示：“这家银行并非要成为又一家普通金融机构。我们设想将其打造为一家‘最后一公里银行’，让金融服务更贴近那些以创业和辛勤付出支撑我们市场及地方经济的女性。”

According to a statement issued by Smith’s office on Monday, the session is titled ‘One Year Later: Assessing Nigeria’s Efforts to Protect Christians and Secure the Middle Belt’, with hearing scheduled for 11am at the Rayburn House Office Building in Washington, DC. The first panel will feature Frank Garcia, Assistant Secretary of State for African Affairs, and Riley Barnes, Assistant Secretary of State for Democracy, Human Rights and Labour. The second panel will include Nina Shea, senior fellow and director of the Centre for Religious Freedom at the Hudson Institute; Ryan Brown, chief executive officer of Open Doors US; and Oge Onubogu, director and senior fellow of the Africa Programme at the Centre for Strategic and International Studies. This will be Smith’s 14th congressional hearing exclusively on Nigeria. In November 2025, he chaired a hearing after President Donald Trump’s redesignation of Nigeria as a ‘country of particular concern’. In May 2016, he also chaired a hearing on “The U.S. role in helping Nigeria confront Boko Haram and other threats in northern Nigeria.” Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof

https://leadership.ng/millions-fill-buen.summary: Argentines stretched for miles down the Avenida del Libertador, waving the white-and-yellow Vatican flag and pressing against security barriers for a glimpse of the pontiff at the largest event yet of the pope’s 12-day South American tour, and of his 18-month tenure leading the global Catholic Church. https://leadership.ng/millions-fill-buen.summary_zh: 阿根廷人沿着解放者大道绵延数英里，挥舞白黄两色的梵蒂冈旗帜，挤在安保隔离栏前，只为一睹教宗尊容。这是教宗南美12日行程中规模最大的一场活动，也是他领导全球天主教会18个月任期内的最大活动。晴空之下，教宗乘坐敞篷教宗车驶来，街道两旁树木成行，“教皇利奥万岁！”的欢呼声回荡其间。
https://leadership.ng/millions-fill-buen.body: Argentines stretched for miles down the Avenida del Libertador, waving the white-and-yellow Vatican flag and pressing against security barriers for a glimpse of the pontiff at the largest event yet of the pope’s 12-day South American tour, and of his 18-month tenure leading the global Catholic Church. Chants of “Long live Pope Leo!” echoed down the tree-lined street as the pope was driven by in an open-top popemobile under sunny skies. Leo said in his sermon how happy he was to see Catholics in a region that has long been a stronghold for the Church but where it has been losing ground recently to fast-growing evangelical denominations. “It fills my heart with joy to celebrate… with you,” said the pope. “My visit to this land of Argentina has allowed me to see on your faces the enthusiasm of your faith.” Leo, 71, is on an ambitious 50-event, three-country tour less than a month after undergoing lung cancer surgery. He visited Uruguay before arriving in Argentina on Sunday and will travel on to Peru on Wednesday before returning to Rome on November 17. The first US-born pope spent decades as a missionary in Peru and the Vatican has described the tour, one of the most demanding foreign tours by a pope in decades, as a “homecoming”. People had gathered in the early hours of Monday ahead of the Mass. Some normally bustling parts of the city stood near-empty as police cordoned off a security zone. Vendors along the pilgrims’ route were selling souvenirs of the visit, including flags featuring the pope’s face. “I love that (Leo) is visiting us,” said Claudia Pardo, 37, who waited for Leo with her husband and two young children. “It’s a unique, historic moment, and we should listen to his message.” Alejandra Frias, 56, was sleepless after camping out all night to get a front-row view of the pope. “This is an emotional and spiritual moment,” she said. A pope has not visited majority-Catholic Argentina since 1987. Leo has emerged as a forceful voice on the world stage, lamenting what he sees as a failure of global leadership. On his tour he has urged South American nations to set an example of regional cooperation and patient diplomacy instead of conflict. On Sunday, the pope addressed Argentine President Javier Milei, a libertarian seen as a close ally of US President Donald Trump. He urged Milei, who has pushed an austerity agenda that the Church has strongly criticized for cutting social services, to not target Argentina’s poorest. He also told Milei, a theatrical figure known for bombastic statements, that leaders should be careful with their words and know the limits of their power. The pope lamented the difficulties faced by Argentine families at the Mass on Monday. He said they are enduring “instability, social hardship, precarious employment, domestic violence, painful separations and addictions that destroy young people’s futures and damage family relationships.” Ahead of Monday’s Mass, Leo visited a care center for people with disabilities on the southern outskirts of Buenos Aires, where thousands had also gathered in hope of seeing him. Jorge Silanes, religious director of the Pequeño Cottolengo Don Orione center that welcomed Leo, said the visit carried added significance because Milei’s spending cuts have reduced disability benefits while poverty remains widespread. “A nation’s progress is also measured by how it welcomes all people with disabilities and particular needs,” said the pope. https://leadership.ng/millions-fill-buen.title_zh: 教宗利奥赞扬南美教会的坚韧，数百万民众涌上布宜诺斯艾利斯街头
https://leadership.ng/millions-fill-buen.body_zh: 阿根廷人沿着解放者大道绵延数里，挥舞白黄相间的梵蒂冈旗帜，挤压在安保隔离栏前，只为一睹教宗尊容。这是教宗为期12天的南美洲巡访问中迄今规模最大的一场活动，也是他领导全球天主教会18个月任期中的最大一场活动。晴空之下，教宗乘坐敞篷教皇专车驶入林荫街道时，“教皇利奥万岁！”的欢呼声回荡在街道两旁。利奥在布道中说，他看到该地区的天主教徒感到无比高兴；那里长期以来一直是教会的据点，但近年来正被迅速壮大的福音派教派蚕食。“能与你们共同庆祝……我的心充满喜悦，”教宗说。“我对阿根廷这片土地的访问，让我从你们的脸上看到了你们信仰的热情。”现年71岁的利奥正在接受一项雄心勃勃的访问计划，足迹涉及3个国家、50场活动；就在接受肺癌手术不到一个月后，他便开始了此次巡访。他先访问了乌拉圭，随后于星期日抵达阿根廷；星期三将前往秘鲁，并于11月17日返回罗马。这位美国出生的首位教宗曾在秘鲁传教数十年，梵蒂冈将此次行程——近几十年来教宗行程中最繁重的一次海外巡访——称为一次“回家”。星期一凌晨，人们便聚集在弥撒活动现场附近等待。警方划定安全区后，平日熙熙攘攘的部分城区几乎空无一人。朝圣者沿途的商贩正在出售此次访问的纪念品，包括印有教宗肖像的旗帜。37岁的克劳迪娅·帕尔多与丈夫和两个年幼的孩子一起等待利奥，她说：“我很喜欢（利奥）来访我们。这是一个独一无二、具有历史意义的时刻，我们应当聆听他的信息。”56岁的阿莱杭德娅·弗里亚斯为了占据前排观看教宗的位置，整夜在户外露营，无眠难眠。她说：“这是一个充满情感与精神意义的时刻。”自1987年以来，教宗一直没有访问这个天主教徒占多数的阿根廷。利奥已成为世界舞台上一位有力的发声者，对他所见的全球领导失序深表遗憾。巡访期间，他敦促南美洲各国以区域合作和耐心外交作出榜样，而非诉诸冲突。星期日，教宗对阿根廷总统哈维尔·米莱发表讲话。米莱是一名自由意志主义者，被视为美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的亲密盟友。教宗敦促推行紧缩政策、削减社会服务并因此遭到教会强烈批评的米莱，不要针对阿根廷最贫困的人群。他还告诫以夸张言辞著称的戏剧化人物米莱，领导人应当谨慎措辞，并了解自身权力的边界。星期一举行弥撒时，教宗为阿根廷家庭所面临的困境深感痛心。他说，这些家庭正在承受“社会不稳定、困苦生活、脆弱就业、家庭暴力、令人痛心的分离，以及摧毁年轻人未来、损害家庭关系的成瘾问题”。星期一弥撒前，利奥探访了布宜诺斯艾利斯南郊的一所残障人士照护中心，数千人也在那里聚集，满怀希望想见到他。接待利奥的佩克尼约·科托伦戈·唐·奥里奥内中心宗教主任豪尔赫·西拉内斯说，此次访问具有更重要的意义，因为米莱削减开支导致残障福利减少，而贫困现象依然普遍。教宗说：“一个国家的进步，也体现在它如何接纳所有残障人士及有特殊需要的人。”利奥任教皇期间此前规模最大的活动发生在今年6月，当时这位教宗访问西班牙，约有120万人湧上马德里街头迎接。我们掌握独家优势。实时报道、独家爆料和独家视角直接送达你的手机。别再满足于过时新闻。加入 LEADERSHIP NEWS WhatsApp 频道，获取全天候最新动态 →

https://leadership.ng/makinde-presents-2.body: Preparations are building up at the Oyo State House of Assembly, Parliament Building, Secretariat, Ibadan, ahead of the presentation of the state’s 2027 Appropriation Bill. The presentation is expected to attract government officials, lawmakers, guests, and other stakeholders to witness the unveiling of the proposed budget for the 2027 fiscal year. As at the time of filing this report, lawmakers and guests were gradually converging on the venue, while top government functionaries had also begun arriving for the event. Among those who had arrived were the Deputy Governor of Oyo State, Barrister Bayo Lawal; the Secretary to the State Government, Professor Musibau Babatunde; the Chief of Staff to the Governor, Akinwale Akinwole; and commissioners overseeing the Ministries of Information, Culture and Tourism, Works and Transport, and Health. Other political appointees and government officials were also arriving at the Assembly complex as preparations continued ahead of the formal proceedings. The gathering is still awaiting the arrival of the Speaker of the Oyo State House of Assembly, Adebo Ogundoyin, and Governor Seyi Makinde, whose presence is expected to precede the budget presentation. The 2027 budget presentation is particularly significant, as it will be the last appropriation bill presented by Governor Makinde during his administration. The proposed estimates are expected to outline the government’s revenue projections, expenditure plans, and development priorities for the 2027 fiscal year, with likely attention to key sectors, ongoing projects, and programmes planned for the final year of the administration. https://leadership.ng/information-minist.summary: Responding to concerns raised by BON over the rising cost of operating broadcast stations, the Minister reaffirmed the federal government’s commitment to creating a conducive environment for the growth and sustainability of the industry. “Any increase in licence fees is hereby put on hold.
https://leadership.ng/information-minist.summary_zh: 针对广播公司协会（BON）提出的广播电视台运营成本上升问题，这位部长重申联邦政府致力于营造有利于该行业发展和可持续经营的环境。“任何上调许可证费用的措施现已暂缓执行。
https://leadership.ng/information-minist.body: Idris announced the decision in Abuja when he received a delegation of the Broadcasting Organisations of Nigeria (BON), led by its Chairman, Senior High Chief Dr Tony Akiotu, following the organisation’s 82nd General Assembly. Responding to concerns raised by BON over the rising cost of operating broadcast stations, the Minister reaffirmed the federal government’s commitment to creating a conducive environment for the growth and sustainability of the industry. “Any increase in licence fees is hereby put on hold. All reviews relating to licences are suspended until further notice. I am directing the NBC to ensure strict compliance while we review the situation,” he said. The minister also directed the Director-General of the National Broadcasting Commission (NBC) to expedite the review of the National Broadcasting Code to ensure that the regulatory framework reflects developments and emerging realities in the broadcasting industry. On the Digital Switch-Over (DSO), Idris promised to convene a stakeholders’ meeting to address outstanding issues affecting the programme. Addressing BON’s request for the enforcement of the 45-day payment period for advertising services, the minister disclosed that he had already directed the Advertising Regulatory Council of Nigeria (ARCON) to ensure full implementation of the policy. He further assured the delegation that the ministry would engage relevant stakeholders on concerns relating to access to affordable financing and spectrum allocation. Idris emphasised the critical role of broadcasting in strengthening democracy, promoting national cohesion and ensuring that citizens have access to credible and accurate information. He urged broadcasters to uphold the highest standards of professionalism, fairness and ethical journalism, particularly as the country prepares for the 2027 general elections. “Freedom of expression must go with responsibility. You cannot simply say anything and claim to be practising journalism. Journalism has standards, procedures and ethics. I urge broadcasters to ensure that what they report is factual, responsible and promotes national unity and peaceful coexistence,” the minister said. Earlier, BON chairman, Akiotu, commended the minister for his intervention during the June 2026 DSO launch, noting that the stakeholders’ meeting he convened helped address concerns about ensuring a level playing field for operators. Akiotu identified several challenges confronting the industry, including the review of the National Broadcasting Code, broadcast licence fees, rising operational costs, access to financing, spectrum allocation and the implementation of the 45-day advertising payment period. “BON believes in dialogue, consultation and mediation to prevent a breakdown of industrial harmony in the broadcasting industry. We are grateful for your personal intervention during the DSO launch and seek your continued support in addressing the challenges affecting our members,” he said. The minister congratulated BON on the successful hosting of its 82nd General Assembly in Calabar, Cross River State, and reiterated the federal government’s commitment to sustained dialogue and collaboration with broadcasting stakeholders to strengthen the industry and promote its long-term development. https://leadership.ng/information-minist.body_zh: 伊德里斯在阿布贾接见由主席、高级酋长托尼·阿基奥图博士率领的尼日利亚广播组织（BON）代表团后宣布了这一决定。此次会面是在该组织举行第82届大会之后进行的。针对BON提出的广播站运营成本不断上升等关切，这位部长再次确认了联邦政府致力于营造有利环境，推动广播行业增长和可持续发展的承诺。他说：“现决定暂停任何广播许可证费的上涨。在另行通知前，所有与许可证有关的审查均予暂停。我已指示NBC在审查局势期间确保严格遵守规定。”部长还指示国家广播委员会（NBC）总司长加快审查《国家广播守则》，确保监管框架反映广播行业的发展和新出现的实际情况。在数字转换（DSO）方面，伊德里斯承诺召集利益相关方会议，处理影响该计划的遗留问题。针对BON要求执行广告服务45天付款期的请求，部长透露，他已经指示尼日利亚广告监管委员会（ARCON）确保该政策得到全面落实。他进一步向代表团保证，部里将就获得可负担融资和频谱分配等关切与相关利益方磋商。伊德里斯强调，广播在巩固民主、促进国家凝聚力以及确保公民能够获得可信、准确的信息方面发挥着关键作用。他敦促广播机构坚守最高标准的专业精神、公平原则和新闻伦理，特别是在该国筹备2027年大选之际。他说：“言论自由必须与责任相伴。不能随口说什么都说是实践新闻业。新闻业有标准、程序和伦理。我敦促广播机构确保其报道内容符合事实、负责任，并促进国家统一与和平共处。”此前，BON主席阿基奥图赞扬部长在2026年6月DSO启动期间所作的干预，并指出部长召集的利益相关方会议有助于解决确保运营商公平竞争环境等方面的关切。阿基奥图列举了行业面临的若干挑战，包括审查《国家广播守则》、广播许可证费、运营成本上升、融资渠道、频谱分配以及落实广告45天付款期等。他说：“BON相信对话、协商和调解有助于防止广播行业产业和谐破裂。我们感谢您在DSO启动期间亲自介入，并寻求您继续支持，以解决影响我们成员的挑战。”部长祝贺BON在克罗罗州卡拉巴尔成功举办第82届大会，并再次重申联邦政府将与广播行业利益相关方持续开展对话与合作，以加强该行业并促进其长期发展。我们掌握独家优势。实时报道、独家内幕和独家视角将直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp频道，接收全天候最新消息 → 加入我们的WhatsApp频道 --> --> 桑松·伊莱亚 桑松·伊莱亚是《Leadership Newspaper》记者，专攻政治报道和公共事务分析。他因深入进行专题分析、超越表面报道而广受认可，在负责领域内赢得了值得信赖和权威的声音

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/us-m.title: US-mediated talks with Russia and Ukraine to start in Abu Dhabi
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/us-m.summary: Negotiators from Ukraine, Russia and the United States will hold talks in Abu Dhabi Tuesday on ending Europe’s worst conflict since World War II in the first such meeting in more than nine months, as another winter of war approaches. Trump has pushed for an end to the Russia-Ukraine war since returning to power, but previous talks produced no breakthroughs and the process became sidelined by the US-Israeli war against Iran.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/us-m.summary_zh: 乌克兰、俄罗斯和美国的谈判代表将于周二在阿布扎比举行会谈，讨论结束欧洲自第二次世界大战以来最为严重的冲突。随着又一个战争寒冬临近，这将是九个月多以来举行的首次此类会谈。特朗普重新掌权后一直推动结束俄乌战争，但此前的会谈没有取得突破，该进程也因美以对伊朗的战争而被搁置。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/us-m.body: Layer 1 Russia’s Ambassador to the UN Vasily Nebenzya speaks during a UN Security Council meeting on Ukraine at the United Nations headquarters in New York on November 9, 2026. Photo by ANGELA WEISS / AFP. Negotiators from Ukraine, Russia and the United States will hold talks in Abu Dhabi Tuesday on ending Europe’s worst conflict since World War II in the first such meeting in more than nine months, as another winter of war approaches. Europe – alarmed by US President Donald Trump floating a deal with Moscow on European security ahead of the talks – will also send representatives to Abu Dhabi. Trump has pushed for an end to the Russia-Ukraine war since returning to power, but previous talks produced no breakthroughs and the process became sidelined by the US-Israeli war against Iran. Europe and Ukraine fear the United States will force a deal on Kyiv that would amount to a de-facto capitulation, with Trump appearing to pivot towards Moscow this year. Moscow’s invasion of Ukraine has killed hundreds of thousands, displaced millions and has dragged on for 56 months, with the Kremlin showing no sign of backing down. Russia occupies large swathes of Ukraine but, while its troops have grinded westwards, they have not been able to seize the whole of the Donetsk region. Moscow demands Kyiv surrender the parts of the region it still controls, vowing it will otherwise press on with its offensive. Ukraine – which for more than 4.5 years has resisted a far larger invading army at a huge human cost – has ruled out such a withdrawal. Russia pummelled Ukraine in the run-up to the talks and carried out one of its deadliest strikes yet – with Kyiv saying 55 people were killed in a frontline village as they queued for humanitarian aid. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the intensified strikes were part of Moscow’s strategy of “putting pressure on Ukraine’s position” at the negotiations. Russia’s Vladimir Putin, who launched the war in February 2022, has repeatedly refused broader ceasefire offers and face-to-face talks with Zelensky. Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner and special envoy Steve Witkoff will gather the enemy sides in Abu Dhabi for the first time since February, when negotiations took place in Geneva. Russia and Ukraine have held several rounds of failed talks during almost five years of war and hopes for peace are low. “We don’t have any particular expectations,” a senior Ukrainian official in Kyiv told AFP. Trump last week floated a “very big agreement” on the war that will “involve all of Europe”, stoking fears Washington would collaborate with Moscow on creating a new European security architecture. Shortly before launching its 2022 invasion, Moscow had issued an ultimatum to the West for NATO to rollback troops from Eastern Europe. The diplomat who issued the demand, Sergei Ryabkov, will for the first time be part of Moscow’s delegation, which is headed by Putin’s nationalistic aide Vladimir Medinsky. “For Europe, it is clear: we do not need to establish a new security architecture for Europe,” German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul said Monday. He urged Moscow to “give up maximalist demands” and warned against any “negotiation show” in the UAE capital. Zelensky has warned of a “Yalta 2.0” referring to Western leaders dividing Europe with the USSR in 1945. According to Ukraine’s chief negotiator Rustem Umerov, representatives from the UK, France, Germany and Italy, as well as NATO and EU officials will hold separate talks with Kyiv’s representatives in Abu Dhabi. The Kremlin – which has sought to keep Europe out of the talks – said negotiations will remain “trilateral”. A recent ceasefire in the Kherson region was “a very positive precedent”, Ukrainian political expert Volodymyr Fesenko told AFP, predicting Kyiv will look for “de-escalation of the war through such local truces”. Kushner and Witkoff have been accused by critics of being soft on Russia and US media have reported that the Americans are pushing large back-door business deals with Moscow. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/us-m.title_zh: 美国斡旋的俄罗斯与乌克兰会谈将在阿布扎比启动
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/us-m.body_zh: 第一层：俄罗斯常驻联合国大使瓦西里·涅本齐亚于2026年11月9日在纽约联合国总部举行的联合国安理会乌克兰问题会议上发言。ANGELA WEISS / AFP 摄。乌克兰、俄罗斯和美国的谈判代表将于周二在阿布扎比会谈，讨论如何结束欧洲自第二次世界大战以来最严重的冲突。这是九个月多以来首次举行此类会议，而又一个战火寒冬即将到来。欧洲——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在会谈前提及可能与莫斯科就欧洲安全达成协议，令欧洲深感不安——也将派代表赴阿布扎比。特朗普重新掌权后一直推动结束俄乌战争，但此前的会谈没有取得突破，美国和以色列对伊朗的战争也使谈判进程被搁置。欧洲和乌克兰担心，美国会迫使基辅接受一项实际上意味着投降的协议，而特朗普今年似乎正转向支持莫斯科。莫斯科入侵乌克兰已造成数十万人死亡、数百万人流离失所，战争也已持续56个月，但克里姆林宫没有迹象会退让。俄罗斯占领了乌克兰大片领土，但其部队虽然向西艰难推进，仍未能夺取顿涅茨克州全境。莫斯科要求基辅 surrender 该地区仍由乌方控制的区域，并声称否则将继续推进攻势。乌克兰——4年多来以巨大人员代价抵抗着规模远大于己方的入侵军队——已排除撤军的可能。俄罗斯在会谈前夕对乌克兰进行猛烈打击，并发动了迄今最致命的空袭之一。基辅称，在一个前线村庄，民众排队领取人道主义援助时，55人死亡。乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，升级的打击是莫斯科在谈判中“向乌克兰的立场施压”战略的一部分。俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京于2022年2月发动战争，此后多次拒绝更广泛的停火提议以及与泽连斯基举行面对面会谈。特朗普的女婿贾里德·库什纳和特使史蒂夫·威特科夫将在阿布扎比召集交战双方。这是2月在日内瓦举行谈判以来双方首次聚首。俄乌两国在近五年的战争中已举行数轮失败的会谈，和平希望渺茫。乌克兰一名高级官员在基辅告诉法新社：“我们没有任何特别预期。”特朗普上周提出就战争达成一项“非常重大的协议”，并将“让整个欧洲参与”，这加剧了人们对华盛顿会与莫斯科合作建立新的欧洲安全架构的担忧。就在2022年发动入侵前不久，莫斯科曾向西方发出最后通牒，要求北约从东欧撤军。提出这一要求的外交官谢尔盖·梁布科夫将首次成为莫斯科代表团成员。代表团由普京的民族主义助手弗拉基米尔·梅德斯基率领。德国外长约翰·瓦德普尔周一表示：“对欧洲来说，结论很清楚：我们不需要为欧洲建立新的安全架构。”他敦促莫斯科“放弃最大化主义要求”，并警告不要在阿联酋首都上演任何“谈判秀”。泽连斯基曾警告出现“雅尔塔2.0”，指的是西方领导人在1945年与苏联瓜分欧洲。乌克兰首席谈判代表鲁斯特姆·乌梅罗夫表示，英国、法国、德国和意大利的代表，以及北约和欧盟官员，将在阿布扎比分别与基辅代表会谈。克里姆林宫一直设法将欧洲排除在会谈之外，并称谈判仍将保持“三边”形式。乌克兰政治专家弗拉基米尔·费先科告诉法新社，赫尔松地区近期实现的停火是“一个非常积极的先例”，并预测基辅将寻求“通过这类地方停战实现战争降级”。批评者指责库什纳和威特科夫对俄罗斯态度软弱，美国媒体报道称，美国人正推动与莫斯科达成大规模幕后商业交易。此处表达的观点不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的意见。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 尽管德黑兰表示反对，内阁仍批准扩大部署。韩国面临一项外交挑战：伊朗警告称，扩大清海部队在霍尔木兹海峡附近的使命并非干预当前的美伊战争，韩国可能会被描绘成美国军事袭击的“同谋”。韩国外交部没有说明其是否在扩大任务宣布之前或之后向伊朗传达了有关清海部队问题的立场。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Cabinet approves expanded deployment despite Tehran's objections Korea is facing a diplomatic challenge in convincing Iran that the Cheonghae Unit’s expanded mission closer to the Strait of Hormuz is not an intervention in the ongoing U.S.-Iran war, as the Middle Eastern country warned Korea could be “portrayed as an accomplice” of U.S. military attacks. Although Korea’s defense authorities reiterated that the unit's expanded duties do not cover the strait but rather are aimed at protecting Korean vessels from piracy, experts say it seems Seoul’s message has not been delivered as intended. This raises concerns that Iran could view the move as entry into the war and lead to potential clashes. The concerns come after Iranian foreign ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei delivered a briefing on Monday (local time). “South Korea should keep itself away from entering into an issue that is already complicated enough,” Baghaei said, according to local media reports. "It should refrain from deploying military forces to the region under the name of supporting the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz." He noted that Tehran and Seoul have maintained relations for more than 60 years based on mutual respect and shared interests. “The Iranian people do not expect countries other than the United States, the Zionist regime and their allies to join their military aggression against Iran,” Baghaei added, using the term "Zionist regime” to refer to Israel. He expressed hope that Korea "will not be portrayed as an accomplice of U.S. military aggression," and that "Korea and the international community will pay attention to wide and harmful impacts that the illegal activities by the U.S. and Israel could bring about." Tehran’s warning came hours after Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul rejected criticism and concerns that expanding the Cheonghae Unit’s operation area from the Gulf of Aden to waters south of Oman could provide a backdoor to deploy forces to the Hormuz Strait. “We have clearly stated our principle of noninvolvement and noninterference in the war,” Kang said at a parliamentary National Defense Committee meeting. He added that Korea would retain its own command structure and that the expansion is intended to protect Korean service members, nationals and vessels, citing a more than threefold increase in pirate activity. Korea's foreign ministry did not clarify whether it delivered its stance on the Cheonghae Unit issue to Iran before or after the mission expansion announcement. He also stressed that the purpose of the extended mission is to protect Korean nationals and economic interests, under the principle of noninvolvement and nonintervention in the war. Analysts found the defense and foreign ministries’ explanations insufficient to reassure Tehran of Seoul’s commitment to avoid involvement in the conflict in the strait. “It is unclear whether Seoul adequately explained the Cheonghae Unit’s expanded mission to Tehran before announcing it,” a researcher at a private think tank said on condition of anonymity. Kwak Jin-o, a research professor at Pai Chai University, also warned of the risks posed by differing perceptions of the deployment. “Seoul needs to make sure Iran understands that Korea is staying out of the war,” he said. “Activities such as supporting other countries’ operations could send a different message to Tehran and increase the risk of an accidental clash.” On Tuesday, the Cabinet approved a motion at its weekly meeting to extend the unit’s deployment area. The proposal will be submitted to the National Assembly shortly after the remaining procedures are completed
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 【封面报道】伊朗的警告表明，首尔为清海任务开展的外交努力仍不够充分
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 尽管德黑兰提出反对，韩国内阁仍批准扩大部署行动。韩国在说服伊朗方面面临外交挑战：韩国清海部队扩大后的任务地点更接近霍尔木兹海峡，但这并不意味着介入正在进行的美国与伊朗战争。这个中东国家警告称，韩国可能会被描绘成美国军事袭击的“帮凶”。尽管韩国国防部门重申，该部队扩大后的职责不涉及这条海峡，而是旨在保护韩国船只免遭海盗袭击，但专家认为，首尔的表态似乎没有按预期传达给伊朗。这引发了对伊朗可能将此举视为参战并导致潜在冲突的担忧。伊朗外交部发言人埃斯梅尔·巴加埃周一（当地时间）举行记者会并作出上述说明。据当地媒体报道，巴加埃说：“韩国应当远离这个已经足够复杂的问题。”“韩国不应以支持霍尔木兹海峡重新开放为名，向该地区部署军队。”他指出，德黑兰与首尔60多年来一直保持相互尊重和共同利益基础上的关系。巴加埃补充说：“伊朗人民不期待除美国、犹太复国主义政权及其盟友之外的其他国家加入针对伊朗的军事侵略。”他用“犹太复国主义政权”一词指代以色列。他表示，希望韩国“不会被描绘成美国军事侵略的帮凶”，并希望“韩国和国际社会将关注美国和以色列的非法活动可能带来的广泛而有害的影响”。德黑兰发出警告数小时后，国防部长姜成烈驳斥了有关扩大清海部队行动区域、从亚丁湾延伸至阿曼以南水域可能为向霍尔木兹海峡部署兵力提供后门的批评和担忧。姜成烈在国会国防委员会会议上说：“我们已经清楚说明了我们不介入和不干涉战争的立场。”他补充说，韩国将保留自己的指挥架构，扩大行动旨在保护韩国军人、国民和船只，并援引海盗活动增加三倍多的情况。韩国外交部没有说明，在宣布扩大任务之前还是之后向伊朗传达了有关清海部队问题的立场。他还强调，根据不介入和不干涉战争的原则，延长任务的目的是保护韩国国民和经济利益。分析人士认为，国防部和外交部的解释不足以让德黑兰放心，无法确信首尔会避免介入该海峡的冲突。一家私营智库的研究员在匿名条件下说：“尚不清楚首尔是否在宣布清海部队扩大任务之前，向德黑兰充分解释了相关情况。”培材大学研究教授郭振浩也警告说，双方对部署行动的看法不同会带来风险。他说：“首尔需要确保伊朗理解，韩国不会参战。”“支持其他国家开展行动等行为可能向德黑兰传递不同的信息，并增加意外冲突的风险。”周二，内阁在每周会议上批准了一项延长该部队部署区域的动议。完成其余程序后，该提案将很快提交国会。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: A former U.S. diplomat said Tuesday that the envisioned transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) from Washington to Seoul may not move forward swiftly, citing "no consensus" on the key alliance issue in the United States. Speaking virtually at a forum, Joseph Yun, former acting U.S. ambassador to South Korea and special representative for North Korea, also said that there is no consensus in Washington over Seoul's push to secure rights to enrich uranium for peaceful civilian purposes and acquire nuclear submarines. Yun offered his forecasts over what will happen during the remaining two years of U.S. President Donald Trump's administration, particularly in the wake of this month's U.S. midterm elections, in which Democrats won control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives. "I cannot imagine (the OPCON transfer efforts) moving very rapidly," Yun said during the forum hosted by the Korea-U.S. Parliamentarians' Union. "Same thing with nuclear issues. There is no consensus in Washington that Korea ought to have enrichment or nuclear submarines." South Korea and the U.S. have been working on the "conditions-based" OPCON transfer without a target year for the transition. Seoul wants to retake wartime OPCON before the five-year term of President Lee Jae Myung's administration ends in 2030, while Washington highlights the importance of fulfilling the conditions for the transfer. The allies have also agreed on bilateral cooperation on the uranium enrichment issue, as well as the nuclear submarine project, as stipulated in a joint fact sheet released last year to outline bilateral summit agreements between Lee and Trump. Commenting on the OPCON transfer efforts, Yun raised concerns that the transition could weaken the bilateral alliance, arguing that South Korea views the transfer as a "political" issue while it is a "technical" issue in the U.S. "In South Korea, people want to have the OPCON back with no weakening of the alliance. That is impossible," he said. "Of course, if the Korean capability is so great, a little bit of weakening of the alliance is OK. Then, that's OK. But that's a political decision South Korea has to make." His remarks appear to align with a view that after the U.S. transfers wartime OPCON to Seoul, its security burden would lessen, potentially weakening its military commitment to the Asian ally — a development that some say could be offset by South Korea's growing military capabilities. In Seoul, the OPCON transfer has long been a divisive issue. Proponents say that the transfer is equated with the "restoration" of the country's "military sovereignty," while opponents argue that the transfer could undercut the bilateral alliance amid North Korea's evolving nuclear threats. South Korea handed over operational control of its troops to the U.S.-led U.N. Command during the 1950-53 Korean War. It was then transferred to the allies' Combined Forces Command when the command was launched in 1978. Seoul retook peacetime OPCON in 1994, but wartime OPCON still remains in U.S. hands
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 前美国外交官称，OPCON移交可能进展缓慢，并援引华盛顿“未达成共识”的说法
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 一名前美国外交官周二表示，将战时作战指挥权（OPCON）从华盛顿移交给首尔的设想可能无法迅速推进，原因是美国国内在这一关键盟友问题上“尚未形成共识”。曾任美国驻韩国代办、朝鲜问题特别代表的约瑟夫·云在一场线上论坛上说，对于首尔争取获得和平民用铀浓缩权利以及采购核潜艇的努力，华盛顿同样没有共识。云就美国总统唐纳德·特朗普本届政府任期剩余两年内可能发生的情况作出预测，尤其是美国本月中期选举之后的前景；在此次选举中，民主党赢得了参议院和众议院的控制权。约瑟夫·云在韩国—美国议员联盟主办论坛上说：“我无法想象（移交OPCON的努力）会非常迅速地推进。”“核问题也是如此。华盛顿尚未就是否应当让韩国拥有浓缩能力或核潜艇形成共识。”韩国和美国一直在推进以“条件”为基础的OPCON移交，但尚未设定过渡的目标年份。首尔希望在李在明总统本届政府五年任期于2030年结束前收回战时OPCON，而华盛顿则强调完成移交条件的重要性。根据去年发布的一份联合情况说明书，双方还就铀浓缩问题以及核潜艇项目达成双边合作协议；该文件旨在说明李在明与特朗普举行双边峰会时达成的协议。约瑟夫·云在评论OPCON移交努力时提出担忧，认为这一过渡可能削弱双边联盟。他指出，韩国将移交视为“政治”问题，而美国则将其视为“技术”问题。他说：“在韩国，人们希望收回OPCON，同时不削弱联盟。这是不可能的。”“当然，如果韩国的能力足够强，联盟受到一点削弱也可以接受。那样也可以。但这是韩国必须作出的政治决定。”他的言论似乎与这样一种看法相符：美国将战时OPCON移交给首尔后，其安全负担将有所减轻，进而可能削弱其对这个亚洲盟友的军事投入——一些人认为，韩国不断增强的军事能力可以抵消这一影响。在首尔，OPCON移交长期是一个存在分歧的问题。支持者认为，移交等同于“恢复”该国的“军事主权”；反对者则称，在朝鲜核威胁不断演变的背景下，移交可能削弱双边联盟。1950年至1953年朝鲜战争期间，韩国将其部队的作战指挥权移交给美国主导的联合国军司令部。1978年该司令部成立时，指挥权随后移交给了盟国的联合部队司令部。首尔于1994年收回和平时期OPCON，但战时OPCON仍掌握在美国手中

https://www.lesahel.org/seminaire-bilate.summary_zh: 在中尼合作框架下，中华人民共和国商务部将于2026年11月10日至30日在北京举办面向尼日尔新闻官员和记者的研讨会。该研讨会属于面向发展中国家官员的培训项目，纳入中国对外援助项目，并得到中国领导人的积极支持。
https://www.lesahel.org/seminaire-bilate.body: Dans le cadre de la coopération sino-nigérienne, le Ministère du Commerce de la République Populaire de Chine organise du 10 au 30 novembre 2026, à Pékin, un séminaire dédié aux fonctionnaires de l’information et aux journalistes du Niger. Ce séminaire s’inscrit dans le cadre des programmes de formation destinés aux fonctionnaires des pays en développement, des programmes relevant de l’aide extérieure chinoise et activement encouragés par les dirigeants chinois. Ces échanges et des discussions visent à renforcer l’amitié traditionnelle entre la Chine et le Niger, promouvoir la coopération dans le domaine des médias ainsi que dans d’autres domaines, et contribuer au développement des ressources humaines, de l’économie et de la société. La cérémonie d’ouverture a été présidée par M. ZHU Zhongshu, Directeur adjoint du Centre d’études internationales et de formation du CICG, en présence du chef de la délégation nigérienne, M. Abdoulaye Tiémogo, Conseiller spécial du Président de la République du Niger, responsable de la Cellule de communication de la Présidence. Dans un contexte mondial marqué par la bataille de l’information et la nécessité pour les États du Sud de faire entendre leur propre narratif, cette formation prend tout son sens. Pour le Niger engagé dans une nouvelle dynamique au sein de la Confédération des États du Sahel, la maîtrise de l’information et la professionnalisation des acteurs des médias constituent un enjeu de souveraineté. Le programme est riche et diversifié. Il comprend des conférences thématiques sur les politiques publiques chinoises, le modèle de développement économique et les stratégies de communication, des discussions spécialisées entre professionnels chinois et nigériens sur les défis communs du secteur de l’information, des visites d’étude dans des villes chinoises au sein de groupes de presse, d’entreprises technologiques et d’institutions médiatiques, ainsi que des expériences culturelles pour permettre aux participants de découvrir la richesse historique et culturelle de la Chine. Un programme qui vise à présenter les politiques et expériences de développement de la Chine tout en offrant aux participants nigériens une immersion complète dans l’évolution des médias chinois, de la presse traditionnelle aux nouveaux médias numériques. Ce séminaire témoigne une fois de plus de la vitalité de la coopération entre Niamey et Pékin, une coopération qui se diversifie au-delà des infrastructures pour s’étendre au capital humain et au secteur stratégique de l’information. Il illustre la volonté des deux pays de bâtir un partenariat durable fondé non seulement sur les investissements matériels mais aussi sur le partage de connaissances. Dans son mot de bienvenue, M. ZHU Zhongshu a salué la présence de la délégation nigérienne, soulignant que malgré l’hiver qui s’installe à Beijing, leur présence apporte une chaleur particulière à la rencontre. Il a rappelé que les relations sino-nigériennes poursuivent leur développement régulier avec une coopération élargie dans le pétrole, l’agriculture, la santé, l’éducation et les infrastructures. Il a mis en exergue l’élévation des relations au rang de partenariat stratégique décidée par les deux Chefs d’Etat lors du Sommet de Beijing du Forum sur la coopération sino-africaine en septembre 2024. Selon lui, ce séminaire est une initiative concrète pour mettre en œuvre ce consensus. Il vise à offrir un espace de dialogue direct et d’apprentissage mutuel sur les pratiques journalistiques, la communication internationale et la formation des talents. M. ZHU a également présenté le CICG. Fondée en 1949, cette organisation professionnelle publie plus de 4 000 livres par an en plus de 40 langues et édite 36 revues multilingues. Il a cité l’ouvrage Xi Jinping La gouvernance de la Chine, publié en 44 langues et diffusé dans plus de 180 pays. Il a assuré que le Centre veillera à offrir un accompagnement attentif pour que le séjour soit enrichissant et fructueux, permettant aux participants de découvrir une Chine authentique et de partager à leur retour ce qu’ils auront vu et entendu. S’exprimant au nom de la délégation nigérienne, M. Abdoulaye Tiémogo a exprimé l’honneur de participer à cette rencontre qui célèbre l’amitié des peuples épris de paix et de respect mutuel. Il a indiqué que ce séminaire offre aux participants l’opportunité de se remettre en cause et de questionner les usages et pratiques professionnelles. « Celui qui arrête d’apprendre, cesse d’avancer et qui n’avance pas recule nécessairement. Nous, nous avons choisi d’avancer », a-t-il déclaré. Comparant la coopération sino-nigérienne à une plante ayant germé sur le terreau fertile de la solidarité entre les peuples partageant la même communauté de destin, le Conseil Spécial en communication du Président de la République du Niger a estimé qu’elle a besoin d’être arrosée, entretenue et soutenue pour fleurir. Le cœur de son intervention a porté sur la responsabilité du journaliste. Il a appelé ses confrères à favoriser l’harmonie entre les pays et à contribuer à désamorcer les crises éventuelles. « Loin de nous toute idée de minimiser notre devoir d’informer ou de mépriser le droit d’être informé des publics, mais ce n’est pas parce qu’on a froid dans sa maison qu’on doit y mettre le feu », a martelé M. Abdoulaye Tiemogo. Il a rappelé la puissance des outils du journaliste en ces termes : « avec nos plumes, nos micros et nos caméras, nous pouvons faire bien plus que nous n’imaginons. Car là où le fusil ne sert à rien, nos outils ouvrent les portes les plus verrouillées ». M. Tiémogo a enfin remercié les autorités chinoises pour l’organisation du séminaire et pour l’accueil chaleureux depuis l’arrivée de la délégation nigérienne en terre chinoise, en formulant le vœu que Dieu bénisse nos pays et qu’il raffermisse la coopération entre la Chine et nos pays. Point d’orgue de la cérémonie, la remise symbolique des ouvrages de Xi Jinping ‘’La Gouvernance de la Chine’’ et ‘’Sortir de la pauvreté’’ a précédé la clôture. Les deux parties ont conclu sur une note d’optimisme, en réaffirmant leur volonté commune de faire des médias un pilier de la communauté d’avenir partagé Chine-Afrique
https://www.lesahel.org/seminaire-bilate.title_zh: 中国—尼日尔双边研讨会：尼日利亚新闻官员和记者在中国接受培训
https://www.lesahel.org/seminaire-bilate.body_zh: 在中尼合作框架下，中华人民共和国商务部将于2026年11月10日至30日在北京举办面向尼日尔新闻官员和记者的研讨会。此次研讨会属于面向发展中国家官员的培训项目，是中国对外援助项目的一部分，并受到中国领导人的积极推动。这些交流与讨论旨在加强中尼传统友谊，推动媒体及其他领域合作，并为人力资源、经济和社会发展作出贡献。开幕式由中国国际传播中心（CICG）国际研究与培训副主任朱忠书先生主持，尼日尔总统特别顾问、总统府传播-cellscells负责人 Abdoulaye Tiémogo 先生率领的尼日尔代表团出席。在全球信息竞争加剧、南方国家有必要发出自身叙事的背景下，此次培训具有充分的意义。对于正以新姿态参与萨赫勒国家联盟的尼日尔而言，掌握信息并提升媒体从业人员的专业化水平，关乎国家主权。培训内容丰富多样，包括就中国公共政策、经济发展模式和传播战略举办专题讲座，组织中尼新闻从业专家围绕信息行业共同挑战开展专题讨论，分组参观中国城市的新闻机构、科技企业和媒体院校，并安排文化体验，让参与者感受中国悠久而丰富的历史文化。该项目旨在介绍中国的政策和发展经验，同时让尼日尔参与者全面了解中国媒体从传统新闻出版到数字新媒体的发展进程。此次研讨会再次展现了尼亚美与北京之间合作的活力，这种合作已超越基础设施领域，延伸至人力资本和战略信息行业。它体现了两国建设持久伙伴关系的意愿，即不仅依托物质投资，也重视知识共享。朱忠书先生在欢迎辞中欢迎尼日尔代表团出席，强调尽管北京正值寒冬，代表团的到来仍为本次聚会增添了特别的温暖。他指出，中尼关系持续稳步发展，两国在石油、农业、卫生、教育和基础设施等领域的合作不断扩大。他强调，2024年9月中国—非洲合作论坛北京峰会期间，两国元首决定将双边关系提升为战略伙伴关系。他认为，此次研讨会是落实这一共识的具体举措，旨在为新闻实践、国际传播和人才培养提供直接对话与相互学习的平台。朱忠书先生还介绍了CICG。该职业机构成立于1949年，每年以40多种语言出版4000多册图书，并编辑36种多语种期刊。他提到习近平著作《习近平谈治国理政》，该书以44种语言出版，并在180多个国家发行。他保证，中心将提供周到的支持，使参与者此次行程充实而富有成果，让他们认识真实的中国，并在回国后分享所见所闻。Abdoulaye Tiémogo 先生代表尼日尔代表团发言，表示很荣幸参加此次盛会，以纪念爱好和平、尊重彼此的两国人民之间的友谊。他指出，此次研讨会为参与者提供了重新审视并反思职业惯例和实践的机会。他说：“停止学习的人就会停止前进，不前进的人必然后退。我们已经选择前进。”他将中尼合作比作生长在人民团结这片肥沃土壤上的植物；两国人民同属一个命运共同体，这项合作仍需浇水、维护和支持，才能开花结果。他发言的核心是记者的责任。他呼吁同行促进国家之间的和谐，并为化解可能发生的危机作出贡献。Abdoulaye Tiemogo 先生强调：“我们绝不能轻视报道的职责，也绝不能蔑视公众知情权，但不会因为家里寒冷就纵火烧房。”他还这样强调记者工具的力量：“凭借我们的笔、麦克风和摄像机，我们能够做到远超想象的事情。因为在枪支无能为力之处，我们的工具能够打开一道道紧锁的大门。”Tiémogo 先生最后感谢中国有关部门组织此次研讨会，并自尼日尔代表团抵达中国以来给予热情接待，同时祝愿上帝保佑两国，并加强中国与两国的合作。闭幕式的高潮是举行象征性赠书仪式，向尼日尔代表团赠送习近平《习近平谈治国理政》和《摆脱贫困》两部著作，随后会议闭幕。双方以乐观的态度结束会议，再次重申共同意愿，将媒体打造为中非未来命运共同体的支柱

White House special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are once again mediating the talks, which last through Wednesday. Both men have held a series of meetings with officials across Europe and Russia in recent weeks as they engage in a renewed charge of shuttle diplomacy. Delegates from Russia and Ukraine last met in Geneva in February, though negotiations were put on hold following the outbreak of the U.S. Israel war against Iran. Since then, Ukraine and Russia have dramatically ramped up their attacks on each other ’s territory, inflicting significant economic pain and a growing human toll. Kremlin adviser Vladimir Medinsky, an arch-conservative who previously served as Russia’s culture minister, is again serving as the chief negotiator of the Russian delegation. The team also includes senior military and intelligence officials. The primary focus of the latest round of negotiations, Umerov wrote , includes a “cessation of hostilities, reliable post-war security guarantees, Ukraine’s economic recovery and development, as well as humanitarian steps. ” A source in Russia’s delegation told Reuters that Moscow hopes the Abu Dhabi talks will lay the groundwork for key elements of a post-war security framework for Europe. U.S. officials also told the Financial Times that they are looking to resolve the Ukraine war and broader security arrangements for the continent in tandem, but emphasized that European officials should have a seat at the table, something that Moscow has so far rejected . https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Lee says Korea will continue cooperation with US administration
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: President Lee Jae Myung said Tuesday that Korea will continue to closely cooperate with the U.S. administration following the recent U.S. midterm elections, while also seeking to expand bipartisan support in Congress for issues related to the country and the alliance.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 李在明总统周二表示，在美国近期中期选举结束后，韩国将继续与美国政府密切合作，同时争取扩大美国国会对涉及韩国及韩美同盟议题的两党支持。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: President Lee Jae Myung said Tuesday that Korea will continue to closely cooperate with the U.S. administration following the recent U.S. midterm elections, while also seeking to expand bipartisan support in Congress for issues related to the country and the alliance. Lee made the remarks at a Cabinet meeting after the opposition Democratic Party in the United States won control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives in last week's midterm elections. "After the U.S. midterm elections, many changes are expected to take place in the external environment," the Korean president said, instructing officials to prepare thoroughly for any possible changes. "Utmost attention should be paid to minimizing negative effects from external uncertainties on the domestic economy." "More important than anything would be strengthening and expanding the foundation for cooperation and trust between the two countries from the mutually beneficial perspective," Lee added, calling for efforts to ensure the implementation of bilateral diplomatic and security agreements. The president, in particular, stressed the importance of sufficiently protecting national interests and investments of Korean firms. "To that end, (Korea) would need to continue close cooperation with the U.S. administration, while, at the same time, establishing a bipartisan foundation for cooperation in Congress and expanding the scope of communication with the state governments and the economic sector," the president noted. He also stressed the importance of consistency and flexibility amid global uncertainties, pledging to focus on diplomacy that prioritizes national interests and policies benefiting the people
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: Lee称韩国将继续与美国政府合作
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 李在明总统周二表示，在最近举行的美国中期选举之后，韩国将继续与美国政府密切合作，同时争取扩大美国国会两党对涉及韩国及韩美同盟议题的支持。上周美国中期选举后，执政的民主党同时赢得参议院和众议院控制权，李在明是在内阁会议上发表上述言论的。这位韩国总统说：“美国中期选举后，预计外部环境将发生许多变化。”他要求官员们为任何可能的变化做好充分准备。“必须高度关注如何将外部不确定性对国内经济的负面影响降至最低。”李在明补充说：“最重要的是从互利角度出发，加强并扩大两国合作与信任的基础。”他呼吁努力确保双方外交和安全协议得到落实。总统尤其强调，应当充分保护韩国企业的国家利益和投资。总统指出：“为此，（韩国）需要继续与美国政府密切合作，同时在国会建立两党合作基础，并扩大与各州政府和经济部门的沟通范围。”他还强调，在全球不确定性之中保持一致性与灵活性的重要性，并承诺专注于以国家利益和惠及民众的政策为优先的外交工作

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title: The meaning of US midterm elections
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: The resounding defeat of Republicans in the midterm elections has reshaped the political dynamics of the United States. Policymakers in Korea need to view the elections through the lens of both their immediate implications and the broader trajectory of U.S. politics. Voter turnout is still being tabulated but is already the second-highest midterm turnout since 1914, surpassed only by 2018 during Trump’s first term.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 共和党在中期选举中惨败，重塑了美国政治格局。韩国政策制定者需要从直接影响和美国政治更广泛的发展轨迹两个层面审视此次选举。选民投票率仍在统计，但已仅次于2018年，成为自1914年以来第二高的中期选举投票率；2018年的投票率是在特朗普首个任期内创下的。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: The resounding defeat of Republicans in the midterm elections has reshaped the political dynamics of the United States. It has also raised questions about what this shift in political power means for agreements Korea concluded with the Donald Trump administration. In the short term, the only certainty is that the election results will create greater uncertainty in dealing with the U.S. The real question for policymakers is what these shifts may mean for U.S. policy over the medium to long term. Policymakers in Korea need to view the elections through the lens of both their immediate implications and the broader trajectory of U.S. politics. The beginning of the Trump era pulled the U.S. off a largely bipartisan foreign policy course. Assuming that the Republican defeat or Trump’s departure from the White House in 2029 will return U.S. policy to its pre-Trump setting misunderstands current political dynamics. At the same time, assuming the U.S. is now locked into a trajectory set by Trump would also be a mistake. The election was historic not only in scale but also in geography. While some votes are still being counted, Democrats are on track to win the national House popular vote by 13 percentage points, their largest electoral victory in 50 years. The last shift of comparable scale followed the Watergate scandal. Voter turnout is still being tabulated but is already the second-highest midterm turnout since 1914, surpassed only by 2018 during Trump’s first term. Democrats also scored victories in states such as South Carolina and Kansas that were previously considered beyond their reach. The election demonstrated that even amid heightened polarization, significant political change remains possible when voters believe the country is off track. It is also clear that voters want change. The election was fought largely on affordability and the Iran war. Despite Trump entering office pledging to lower prices and avoid new foreign wars, voters drew a clear connection between his tariff policies and rising costs. The war against Iran not only broke Trump’s pledge but also intensified inflationary pressures. In exit polls, 89 percent of voters said the cost of living was a crucial or major factor in their vote, while 74 percent said the same about the Iran war. Democrats will need to address both affordability and the war’s economic consequences if they hope to avoid a reversal of fortune in 2028. In the short term, the results will create significant uncertainty for Korea. Although Trump accepted the election outcome, his decision to name Stephen Miller chief of staff suggests he does not intend to change course. Korea will therefore need to balance relations with Trump while adjusting to an uncertain future. Even if Republicans had maintained control of Congress, progress on amending the 123 Agreement, developing nuclear submarines and transferring Op-Con would have remained challenging. Democrats will need to approach these issues not only through traditional policy lenses but also in the context of geopolitical change and a desire to repair U.S. alliances. The election also represents a break with the Trump era, and what comes next remains unclear. Although the Biden administration maintained many of the first Trump administration’s tariffs, the election has shown that tariffs are unpopular. Only 21 percent of voters believe they have helped the economy, while 66 percent believe they have hurt it. Democrats have traditionally been the more protectionist party, but the election sends a clear signal that the public does not support tariffs at their current level. In the current Congress, Democrats supported lower tariffs on Canada and a few other cases, but which tariffs they may seek to reduce, or which presidential tariff authorities they may seek to reform, remains an open question. How America’s trade policy evolves matters greatly for Korea as it approaches the final two years of the Trump administration. Seoul needs to prevent additional tariff increases, but the assumptions underpinning its agreement with the United States may no longer apply. More importantly, there is no assurance that the next administration will share Trump’s views about the projects Korea should support through its U.S. investments. Projects such as the Alaska pipeline may never move forward. The election also sets the stage for a more stable artificial intelligence (AI) policy. Concern about AI and data centers was one of the few issues on which Democratic and Republican voters broadly agreed. If newly elected Democratic governors and a Democratic Congress can implement AI policies that address public concerns, they could create long-term stability that benefits Korea, even if short-term freezes or restrictions slow data center construction. The rise of Trump disrupted decades of established U.S. policy. But the recent election makes clear that no 2028 presidential contender can win with policies similar to Trump's. It has also opened the door to a broader political realignment that is only beginning to take shape. Over the next two years, Korea will need to prepare for that shift while managing a Trump administration that may resist the changing political winds. Troy Stangarone is a visiting senior fellow at the Korea Economic Institute of America. The views expressed here are the author’s alone
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 共和党在中期选举中遭遇惨败，重塑了美国政治格局。这也引出了一个重大问题：韩国与唐纳德·特朗普政府达成的协议将如何受到这一政治权力变化的影响。短期内，唯一确定的是，选举结果将增加韩国与美国交涉时的不确定性。政策制定者真正需要回答的问题是，这些变化从中长期来看对美国政策意味着什么。韩国政策制定者需要从其直接影响和美国政治更宏观的发展轨迹两个视角审视此次选举。特朗普时代的开端，使美国偏离了主要由两党共同支持的对外政策路线。认定共和党的败选或特朗普于2029年离开白宫，会让美国政策回归特朗普上台前的状态，是对当前政治动态的误解。与此同时，认定美国如今已锁定在特朗普设定的轨道上，同样是错误的。此次选举不仅在规模上具有历史意义，在地域分布上也是如此。尽管部分选票仍在统计，但民主党有望以13个百分点的优势赢得全国众议院普选票，这将是他们50年来最大的选举胜利。上一次同等规模的格局变化发生在水门事件之后。选民投票率仍在统计，但已经是1914年以来第二高的中期选举投票率，仅低于特朗普第一任期内的2018年。民主党还在南卡罗来纳州、堪萨斯州等此前被认为难以染指的州取得了胜利。选举表明，即使两极分化加剧，只要选民认为国家偏离了正确轨道，重大政治变化仍然可能发生。选民要求改变也显而易见。此次选举主要围绕生活成本和伊朗战争展开。尽管特朗普上任时承诺降低物价、避免发动新的对外战争，但选民明确将他的关税政策与成本上涨联系起来。对伊朗的战争不仅违背了特朗普的承诺，还加剧了通胀压力。在出口民调中，89%的选民表示生活成本是投票时至关重要或重要的因素，74%的选民对伊朗战争持同样看法。如果民主党希望避免2028年时命运逆转，就必须应对生活成本问题以及战争带来的经济后果。短期内，选举结果将给韩国带来显著不确定性。尽管特朗普接受了选举结果，但他任命斯蒂芬·米勒为幕僚长的决定表明，他并不打算改变政策方向。因此，韩国需要在处理与特朗普关系的同时，为不确定的未来作出调整。即使共和党仍控制国会，在修订《123协议》、发展核潜艇以及移转战时作战指挥权方面取得进展也依然困难重重。民主党不仅需要从传统政策视角处理这些问题，还需将地缘政治变化以及修复美国联盟关系的愿望纳入考量。此次选举还意味着与特朗普时代出现断裂，而未来走向仍不明朗。尽管拜登政府保留了特朗普第一任期实施的许多关税，但此次选举表明，关税并不受欢迎。只有21%的选民认为关税帮助了经济，66%的选民认为关税损害了经济。民主党传统上一直是更倾向保护主义的政党，但此次选举发出了明确信号：公众不支持维持当前水平的关税。在本届国会中，民主党支持降低对加拿大及少数其他对象的关税，但他们可能寻求降低哪些关税，或改革哪些总统关税权限，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。随着特朗普政府进入最后两年，美国贸易政策如何演变对韩国至关重要。首尔需要阻止关税进一步上调，但其与美国达成协议所依据的种种假设可能已不再适用。更重要的是，无法保证下一届政府会认同特朗普对韩国应通过在美投资支持哪些项目的看法。阿拉斯加管道等项目可能永远无法推进。此次选举也为更加稳定的人工智能（AI）政策铺平了道路。对人工智能和数据中心的担忧，是民主党与共和党选民普遍意见一致少数议题之一。如果新当选的民主党州长和民主党控制的国会能够实施回应公众关切的AI政策，即使短期冻结或限制措施会拖慢数据中心建设，他们仍有可能为韩国带来有利的长期稳定局面。特朗普的崛起打乱了美国数十年来 established 的政策。但最近的选举清楚表明，2028年任何总统竞选者都无法凭类似特朗普的政策获胜。此次选举也为范围更广的政治重新结盟打开了大门，而这种重新结盟才刚刚开始显现。未来两年，韩国需要为这一变化做好准备，同时应对可能抗拒政治风向变化的特朗普政府。特洛伊·斯坦加罗内是美国韩国经济研究所访问高级研究员。本文所表达的观点仅代表作者本人

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.summary: The Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, has promised N10 million for every councillor who successfully delivered their political ward to Tinubu and other APC candidates in the territory during the 16 January presidential election. Mr Wike rallied total support for Tinubu’s re-election bid, while throwing his weight behind Philip Aduda for the FCT Senate seat and Danladi Chiya for the Abuja South Federal Constituency.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.summary_zh: 联邦首都领地（FCT）部长涅索姆·威克承诺，在1月16日总统选举期间，凡成功为蒂努布及该领地其他全体进步大会党候选人赢得所属选区支持的每名议员，均可获得1000万奈拉。威克先生为蒂努布竞选连任号召全力支持，同时表态支持菲利普·阿杜达竞选FCT参议院席位，并支持丹拉迪·奇亚竞选阿布贾南联邦选区议员。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: The Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, has promised N10 million for every councillor who successfully delivered their political ward to Tinubu and other APC candidates in the territory during the 16 January presidential election. Mr Wike made the promise before a gathering of stakeholders, traditional rulers, and residents during a Rainbow Coalition stakeholders’ meeting in Kwali Area Council on Monday. Unveiling his grassroots mobilisation strategy for the 2027 elections, the minister dismissed critics who call politics too expensive, affirming his commitment to empowering foot soldiers directly. “Any councillor that delivers his ward will get N10 million reward. Therefore, go and meet your leaders, go and meet your youth groups, go and consult with associations. Let’s deliver our ward to Mr President,” he urged. Emphasising that the Rainbow Coalition, which he founded, works strictly for the collective interest of FCT residents, the minister praised the grassroots structure for bridging political divides to champion effective representation and accelerated development. Mr Wike accused opposition parties and political figures of double standards and chronic hypocrisy regarding the nation’s judiciary. The minister took aim at critics who condemned court rulings, specifically the verdict that voided the ticket of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) presidential candidate, Atiku Abubakar. Drawing a sharp contrast between the opposition’s reactions to different legal outcomes, he highlighted how their stance changes depending on who wins in court. “But when they lost a court case, it became: ‘The president is using the court to fight the opposition.’ When it is good for you, the judiciary is clear. When it is bad, you claim they are using it to destroy democracy. What kind of system are we operating?” he questioned. Shifting to local governance, Mr Wike defended his administration’s recent policy to provide brand-new Sport Utility Vehicles (SUVs) to first-class traditional rulers in the FCT, currently being criticised by some political commentators. Dismissing allegations that the vehicles amount to political inducements or bribes, he argued that traditional leaders deserve dignity and respect. “You want a first-class traditional ruler to be walking on the road with a stick in hand, taking public buses so they can get hit by a car one day? But you expect Chief Press Secretaries to Governors, Chairmen, and Presidents to ride SUVs? “Instead of using their platforms to support good things, critics turn it upside down. We will provide for our traditional rulers, and nothing will come out of their complaints,” he said. Reassuring residents of the current administration’s commitment to grassroots development, Mr Wike pointed to transformative infrastructure projects across the satellite towns. The minister noted that the projects included the construction of more than 270 kilometres of roads, with 95 kilometres executed in Kwali alone. He said that the ongoing road projects across the satellite towns were nearing completion and would be inaugurated in December. He urged the electorate to adopt the principle of rewarding proven performance with unwavering support for President Bola Tinubu and other All Progressives Congress (APC) candidates in the 2027 general elections. Mr Wike rallied total support for Tinubu’s re-election bid, while throwing his weight behind Philip Aduda for the FCT Senate seat and Danladi Chiya for the Abuja South Federal Constituency. “I don’t need to preach to you any longer. The one you are seeing is what you follow, not the one that will give you unfulfilled promises. I will go to sleep tonight because I know Kwali, Gwagwalada, and Abaji are 100 per cent for APC,” he declared. Contrasting Tinubu’s inclusive governance with past administrations, the minister listed landmark achievements under the current administration. He identified some of the achievements as the establishment of the FCT Civil Service Commission, the appointment of an FCT Head of Service, financial autonomy for area councils and massive infrastructural upgrades across the satellite towns. He lamented historical marginalisation, pointing out that despite a population of six to seven million, the FCT has long been shortchanged with only one Senate seat and two House of Representatives slots compared to smaller states. “For 50 years, nobody could remember you. The president has changed the narrative, given you your own civil service, allowed you to employ your people, and elevated your traditional stools. You cannot afford to make a mistake in 2027,” he warned. Mr Wike also promised to look into councillors’ salaries in the FCT, following a complaint by the Chairman of the National Councillors Forum of Nigeria, FCT Chapter, Gambo Hamza. Mr Hamza said councillors in the FCT receive N260,000 as a monthly salary and appealed to Mr Wike to intervene. In his remarks, APC Chairman in the FCT, Ishaku Yamawo, applauded Mr Wike for uniting political stakeholders across party lines and successfully anchoring robust development throughout the territory. His PDP counterpart, Mohammed Dogara, thanked Mr Wike for his exemplary work in the territory, assuring him of massive support to ensure Tinubu’s victory. On his part, Aliyu Baka, who spoke on behalf of Rainbow Coalition stakeholders in the FCT, expressed deep regret over the 2023 electoral missteps, declaring that the coalition was fully prepared to ensure total victory for their candidates and Mr Tinubu

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: 联邦首都 Territory（FCT）部长Nyesom Wike承诺，在1月16日总统选举期间，凡成功将所属政治选区拱手献给Tinubu及该地区其他APC候选人的每名议员，都将获得N10 million。Wike先生于星期一在Kwali地方议会举行的Rainbow Coalition利益相关方会议上，在利益相关方、传统君主和居民集会前作出这一承诺。部长公布其为2027年选举制定的基层动员策略，反驳称政治开销过高的批评者，并重申他致力于直接赋能基层工作人员。“任何把选区拱手献上的议员都将获得N10 million奖励。因此，去见你们的领导，去见你们的青年团体，并与各个协会磋商。让我们把自己的选区献给总统先生。”他敦促各方。Wike强调，由他创建的Rainbow Coalition严格致力于FCT居民的集体利益，并称赞这一基层组织架构弥合政治分歧，推动有效代表和加快发展。Wike先生指责反对党及政治人物在国家司法问题上采取双重标准，且长期虚伪。部长抨击那些谴责法院裁决的批评者，尤其是裁定African Democratic Congress（ADC）总统候选人Atiku Abubakar的参选资格无效的判决。他尖锐对比反对派面对不同法律结果时的反应，指出他们的立场会随法院裁决的胜者而改变。“但当他们败诉时，他们就会说：‘总统正在利用法院打击反对派。’当结果对你们有利时，你们就说司法机构公正；当结果对你们不利时，你们又声称他们利用法院摧毁民主。我们运行的是怎样的制度？”他质问道。谈到地方治理，Wike先生为政府近期向FCT一级传统君主提供全新运动型多用途车（SUV）的政策辩护，该政策目前正受到一些政治评论人士的批评。他驳斥有关这些车辆构成政治诱因或贿赂的说法，认为传统领袖理应获得尊严和尊重。“你们想让一级传统君主手里拄着拐杖走在路上、乘坐公共巴士，以至哪天被汽车撞到吗？但你们却期待州长、主席和总统的首席新闻秘书乘坐SUV吗？批评者不但没有利用自己的平台支持有益的事情，反而把事情完全颠倒了。我们会为传统君主提供保障，他们的抱怨不会产生任何结果。”他说。Wike先生向居民保证现任政府致力于基层发展，并指出各卫星城正在实施 transformative 基础设施项目。部长表示，这些项目包括修建270多公里道路，其中仅Kwali一地就完成了95公里。他说，各卫星城正在推进的道路项目已接近完工，将于12月举行启用仪式。他敦促选民秉持以坚定支持回报经实践证明的施政表现这一原则，在2027年大选中支持President Bola Tinubu及其他All Progressives Congress（APC）候选人。Wike先生号召全力支持Tinubu竞选连任，同时表示支持Philip Aduda竞选FCT参议员席位，支持Danladi Chiya竞选Abuja South联邦选区席位。“我不再需要向你们说教。你们亲眼看到的才是你们会追随的，而不是那些只会给你们空洞承诺的人。我今晚可以安心睡觉，因为我知道Kwali、Gwagwalada和Abaji百分之百支持APC。”他宣布。部长将Tinobu的包容性治理与历届政府进行对比，列举了现任政府任期内的标志性成就。他列举的成就包括成立FCT公务员委员会、任命FCT公务员事务主管、赋予地方议会财政自主权，以及对各卫星城进行大规模基础设施升级。他为历史上的边缘化地位感到遗憾，指出尽管FCT人口达六七百万，该地区长期以来仍处于不利地位，与较小的州相比，只有一个参议院席位和两个众议院席位。“50年来，没有人记得你们。总统改变了这种叙事，让你们拥有自己的公务员体系，让你们能够雇用自己的人，并提升了你们传统君主的地位。2027年你们绝不能犯错。”他警告说。继尼日利亚全国议员论坛FCT分会主席Gambo Hamza投诉后，Wike先生还承诺调查FCT议员的薪资问题。Hamza先生说，FCT议员每月领取N260,000薪金，并呼吁Wike先生予以干预。FCT的APC主席Ishaku Yamawo在讲话中称赞Wike先生跨越党派界限团结政治利益相关方，并成功推动全境范围内的稳健发展。他的PDP counterparts Mohammed Dogara感谢Wike先生在FCT的模范工作，并保证将给予大力支持，确保Tinubu获胜。代表FCT Rainbow Coalition利益相关方发言的Aliyu Baka则对2023年的选举失误深表遗憾，并宣称该联盟已做好充分准备，将全力确保其候选人和Tinubu先生取得彻底胜利

https://www.myjoyonline.com/no-new-loans.body: The government plans to mobilise at least US$13 billion for its New Economy Programme over four years without contracting additional loans, Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson has said. He explained that the proposed investment, which will run from 2027 to 2030, would be financed through domestic revenue mobilisation and adjustments to the government's fiscal targets rather than fresh borrowing. Dr Ato Forson gave the assurance during an interaction with students and members of the university community at the Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST), where he addressed questions about how the government intended to fund the initiative. Under the proposed arrangement, 0.5 per cent of GDP would be drawn from government revenue, while another 1 per cent would be made available by lowering the primary surplus target from 1.5 per cent to 0.5 per cent of GDP. The two measures are expected to provide the fiscal space needed to sustain the programme. The Minister also dismissed suggestions that the Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod) generates revenue for the Finance Ministry or the government, explaining that the state's main revenue sources remain direct taxes, indirect taxes and non-tax revenue. On the country's debt position, he reiterated the government's intention to bring public debt down to 45 per cent of GDP by 2028. He pointed to a primary surplus of 2.5 per cent of GDP achieved in 2025 and a projected 1.5 per cent surplus for 2026, saying the combined fiscal outcomes would support a debt reduction of approximately 4 per cent of GDP. He added that the government intends to ease the annual pace of debt reduction to 0.5 per cent of GDP from 2027 to create room for investment in the New Economy Programme. Dr Ato Forson maintained that the strategy would allow the government to pursue its economic transformation agenda without abandoning its commitment to debt sustainability
https://www.myjoyonline.com/no-new-loans.title_zh: 130亿美元新经济计划不会获得新贷款
https://www.myjoyonline.com/no-new-loans.body_zh: 财政部长卡西尔·阿托·福尔松博士表示，政府计划在四年内为“新经济计划”筹集至少130亿美元，同时不新增贷款。他解释说，拟议中的投资将实施于2027年至2030年，资金来源将是国内收入募集以及对政府财政目标的调整，而不是新增借款。阿托·福尔松博士在夸梅·恩克鲁玛科技大学（KNUST）与学生及大学教职人员交流时作出上述保证，并回答了政府打算如何为该倡议提供资金的问题。根据拟议安排，政府将从政府收入中拿出国内生产总值的0.5%，同时通过将基本盈余目标从国内生产总值的1.5%下调至0.5%，释放额外1%的可用资金。这两项措施预计将提供维持该计划所需的财政空间。部长还否定了有关加纳黄金局（GoldBod）为财政部或政府创造收入的说法，并解释说，国家的主要收入来源仍然是直接税、间接税和非税收入。在国家债务方面，他重申政府打算到2028年将公共债务降至国内生产总值的45%。他指出，2025年实现了相当于国内生产总值2.5%的基本盈余，2026年预计也将实现1.5%的盈余，并表示，两项财政成果合计将支持削减约相当于国内生产总值4%的债务。他还补充说，政府打算从2027年起将每年削减债务的幅度放缓至国内生产总值的0.5%，为“新经济计划”的投资腾出空间。阿托·福尔松博士坚持认为，这一战略将使政府能够推进经济转型议程，同时不放弃对债务可持续性的承诺
