https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: N. Korea's nuclear power recognition demand could hinder prospects for Trump-Kim summit: ex-US official
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: North Korea's apparent demand to be recognized as a nuclear power could complicate U.S. President Donald Trump's efforts to arrange another summit with leader Kim Jong-un, a former senior State Department official said Monday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 美国国务院前高级官员周一表示，朝鲜要求被承认为核国家的举动，可能使美国总统唐纳德·特朗普安排再次与领导人金正恩举行峰会的工作变得更加复杂。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korea's apparent demand to be recognized as a nuclear power could complicate U.S. President Donald Trump's efforts to arrange another summit with leader Kim Jong-un, a former senior State Department official said Monday. "I think my understanding, at least, is that the North Koreans have communicated to the United States that the only condition under which there could be consideration for a summit is if the United States accepted North Korea as a nuclear power," Kurt Campbell, former deputy secretary of state, said. Campbell made the remarks during a press briefing hosted by the Asia Group to preview Trump's upcoming trip to Asia, including the Association of Southeast Asian Nations summit in Manila and the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen, China. "Given the current circumstances, I think that would be almost impossible for President Trump to accept," Campbell said, noting that it could face opposition from both Republicans and Democrats in Congress. "I don't think the political circumstances make it likely for anything other than maybe just a handshake of sorts." Campbell, chairman of the Washington-based strategic advisory firm, said that senior members of Trump's team had shown strong interest in reestablishing contact with North Korea during the presidential transition. He also pointed to a subtle competition between Beijing and Moscow for influence over North Korea. "I think China's primary focus right now in North Korea is to ensure that as North Korea works with Russia, that China remains the dominant interlocutor," he said. Trump has repeatedly expressed interest in engaging with Kim again, citing their "good" personal relationship, fueling speculation about a possible meeting during the president's planned visit to China this month. The two leaders had three in-person meetings during Trump's first term: the first in Singapore in June 2018, the second in Hanoi in February 2019 and the third at the inter-Korean border village of Panmunjom. Stephen Biegun, former U.S. special representative for North Korea, also expressed skepticism about the prospects of renewed diplomacy. "All these conditions suggest to me that it will be very difficult to find a pathway to restart diplomacy with North Korea," Biegun said during a separate discussion hosted by the Stimson Center and the Sejong Institute. Biegun suggested that both Trump and Kim may be willing to participate in what he called "performative summitry," but questioned what either side would gain from such a meeting. "It still begs the question, particularly from American interests, why would we want to do this." He nonetheless argued that renewed engagement could help restore security and stability on the Korean Peninsula, while suggesting that Pyongyang might want to find a way to reduce its dependence on Russia and China
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 前美国官员：朝鲜要求承认其核武国家地位，可能妨碍特朗普与金正恩会晤前景
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 朝鲜明显要求被承认为核国家，这可能会使美国总统唐纳德·特朗普再次安排与领导人金正恩举行会晤的努力变得复杂。美国国务院前高级官员周一表示。 美国前常务副国务卿库尔特·坎贝尔说：“至少据我所了解，朝鲜方面已向美国传达，只有一个条件可能被考虑举行首脑会晤，那就是美国承认朝鲜为核国家。”坎贝尔是在亚洲集团主持的新闻发布会上发表上述言论的，以预览特朗普即将进行的亚洲之行，包括在马尼拉举行的东南亚国家联盟峰会，以及在中国深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织峰会。坎贝尔说：“鉴于目前的情况，我认为特朗普总统几乎不可能接受这一点。”他指出，这一立场可能遭到国会共和党议员和民主党议员的反对。他说：“我不认为目前的政治形势会让双方举行除某种形式的握手之外的任何接触成为可能。”身为一家总部位于华盛顿的战略咨询公司负责人的坎贝尔说，在总统交接期间，特朗普团队的高级成员对重新与朝鲜建立联系表现出浓厚兴趣。他还指出，北京与莫斯科之间围绕对朝鲜影响力的微妙竞争正在加剧。他说：“我认为，中国目前在朝鲜的首要重点是确保在朝鲜与俄罗斯合作的同时，中国仍是占主导地位的对话方。”特朗普多次表示有意再次与金正恩接触，并称两人私人关系“良好”，由此引发了外界对两人可能在本月特朗普计划访华期间会晤的猜测。特朗普第一任期内，两国领导人曾面对面会晤3次：第一次是2018年6月在新加坡，第二次是2019年2月在河内，第三次是在朝韩边境村庄板门店。美国前朝鲜问题特别代表斯蒂芬·比根也对恢复外交的前景表示怀疑。比根在史 Stimson 中心与世宗研究院另行主持的讨论中说：“所有这些情况都让我觉得，要找到重启对朝外交的途径将非常困难。”比根认为，特朗普和金正恩或许都愿意参加他所谓的“表演性峰会”，但他质疑双方会从这样的会晤中获得什么。“这仍然提出了一个问题，尤其是从美国利益的角度看，我们为什么要这样做？”不过，他仍主张重新接触有助于恢复朝鲜半岛的安全与稳定，同时暗示平壤可能希望找到一条减少对俄罗斯和中国依赖的途径。

"I do think that chances go up of a meeting after the midterm elections," said Victor Cha, Korea chair at the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS), during a press briefing held to preview potential agendas and meetings during Trump's upcoming trip to Asia. The trip will take Trump to the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) summit in Manila and the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China. He suggested that Pyongyang may have been waiting until after the midterm elections before considering another meeting with Trump, anticipating that he would be in a weaker political position. "They see Trump as weaker and therefore perhaps more vulnerable and easier target," Cha said. He also pointed to Trump's desire to build his diplomatic legacy as another factor that could increase the prospects of renewed engagement with North Korea. "I think the president will be focused on many things, but one of them will be building his legacy," he said. Cha added that North Korea may also want to maintain contact with Trump to avoid unpredictable actions by Washington, citing the president's approach toward Iran and Venezuela. Trump has repeatedly expressed interest in engaging with Kim again, citing their "good" personal relationship, fueling speculation about a possible meeting during the president's planned visit to China this month. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body: The Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) in Gombe State has recorded another wave of defections, with some of its leaders, including the immediate past state chairman, Joel Jagafa, and former Secretary to the State Government (SSG), James Pisagih, joining the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC). The development followed a meeting between the defectors and Governor Muhammadu Yahaya, where they formally declared their decision to join the APC and pledged their support for the governor’s leadership. Others who defected include former PDP State Secretary, Buba Shanu; former Principal Officer of the Gombe State House of Assembly, Sunday Danlele; retired director, Mr Williams; and several other political stakeholders. The meeting, facilitated by Ali Isa, allowed the former PDP chieftains to formally identify with the APC and express their commitment to the party. The defectors said their decision was driven by confidence in Governor Yahaya’s leadership, political direction and the performance of his administration. They also pledged to contribute their political experience, grassroots connections, and networks to strengthen the APC’s structures and mobilise support for the party across the state. Welcoming them, Governor Yahaya described their decision to join the APC as a positive development, noting that their arrival would expand the party’s membership and strengthen its political base in Gombe State. He assured the new members of equal opportunities and inclusiveness, stressing that the APC remained open to individuals willing to work towards the party’s ideals and collective aspirations. The governor expressed confidence that their experience and contributions would support the party’s activities and further consolidate its structures across the state
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.title_zh: 贡贝州：人民民主党前主席、前州安全顾问等加入全进步大会党
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body_zh: 贡贝州人民民主党（PDP）又出现一波人士倒戈，其中包括该党前州主席乔尔·贾加法和前州政府秘书（SSG）詹姆斯·皮萨吉赫，他们加入了执政的全民进步大会（APC）。此次倒戈发生在一场倒戈者与州长穆罕马杜·雅哈亚会面之后。倒戈者在会上正式宣布加入APC，并承诺支持州长的领导。其他倒戈者还包括PDP前州党部秘书布巴·沙努、贡贝州议会大厦前首席官员桑迪·丹莱莱、退休主任威廉姆斯先生，以及其他多名政治人士。此次会议由阿里·Isa主持，使这些前PDP要员正式认同APC，并表达了对该党的忠诚。倒戈者表示，他们作出这一决定，是因为信任雅哈亚州长的领导、政治方向及本届政府的施政表现。他们还承诺贡献自己的政治经验、基层联系和关系网络，以加强APC的组织架构，并在全州动员对该党的支持。雅哈亚州长对他们的加入表示欢迎，称他们决定加入APC是一项积极进展，并指出他们的到来将扩大该党的成员队伍，巩固其在贡贝州的政治基础。他向新成员保证提供平等机会和包容性，强调APC仍对所有愿意为党的理念和集体愿望而努力的人士开放。州长相信，他们的经验和贡献将支持该党开展活动，并进一步巩固该党在全州的组织架构

The Ambassador commended President John Mahama’s efforts but stressed the need for continuity in the government's economic policies.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/government-m.summary_zh: 加纳驻美国大使维克托·史密斯表示，政府已经稳定了经济，目前正将重点转向扩大生产部门。在 JoyNews 对德斯蒙德·丹索的一对一采访中，史密斯大使表示，政府在经济稳定方面取得了进展，现在必须聚焦于扩大生产活动。大使赞扬了总统约翰·马哈马的努力，但强调政府经济政策需要保持连续性。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/government-m.body: Ghana’s Ambassador to the United States, Victor Smith, says the government has stabilised the economy and is now shifting its focus towards expanding the productive sector. He said the initial priority was to address economic challenges, particularly exchange rate instability and high inflation, before turning attention to sectors that can drive production, investment and job creation. Speaking in a one-on-one interview with Desmond Danso on JoyNews, Ambassador Smith said the government had made progress on economic stabilisation and must now focus on growing productive activities. "The initial thing we did was to stabilise an economy which was in complete mess in terms of our exchange rates and inflation and what have you. We've stabilised it. The next thing is to move the productive side," he said. Ambassador Smith said he was engaging investors in the United States to promote business opportunities in Ghana. He identified mining, energy, agriculture and manufacturing as sectors with significant investment potential. "There are big opportunities in mining, energy, agriculture, you name it, manufacturing. We will open up the place to the people," he said. He said attracting foreign investment into these sectors would be important to expanding Ghana’s productive capacity. The Ambassador commended President John Mahama’s efforts but stressed the need for continuity in the government's economic policies. "If what President Mahama is doing so far, I applaud him. But what is important is that we must sustain the effort," he said
https://www.myjoyonline.com/government-m.title_zh: 政府必须巩固经济成果并扩大生产性部门
https://www.myjoyonline.com/government-m.body_zh: 加纳驻美国大使维克托·史密斯表示，政府已经稳定了经济，目前正把重点转向扩大生产部门。他说，政府的首要任务是解决经济挑战，尤其是汇率不稳定和高通胀问题，之后再把注意力转向能够推动生产、投资和就业创造的部门。史密斯大使在JoyNews接受德斯蒙德·丹索一对一采访时表示，政府在经济稳定方面取得了进展，现在必须专注于扩大生产活动。他说：“我们首先做的是稳定经济。当时，我们的外汇率、通货膨胀等方面状况糟透了。我们已经稳定了经济。下一步是推动生产方面的发展。”史密斯大使表示，他正在美国接触投资者，促进加纳的商业机会。他指出，采矿、能源、农业和制造业都是具有巨大投资潜力的部门。他说：“采矿、能源、农业，还有制造业，机会很多。我们会向人们开放这个市场。”他说，吸引外国投资流入这些部门，对扩大加纳的生产能力十分重要。大使赞扬了约翰·马哈马总统的努力，但强调政府经济政策需要保持连续性。他说：“如果马哈马总统迄今所做的一切，我表示赞赏。但重要的是，我们必须坚持这些努力。”

https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-ambass.summary_zh: 加纳驻美国大使维克托·史密斯敦促加纳侨民携投资者回国，为年轻人创造就业和机会。史密斯大使在 JoyNews 对德斯蒙德·丹索的一对一采访中表示，他正在积极接触美国投资者，推介加纳存在的各种机会。史密斯大使鼓励加纳侨民与投资者合作。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-ambass.body: Ghana's Ambassador to the United States, Victor Smith, has urged the Ghanaian diaspora to return home with investors to create jobs and opportunities for young people. Speaking in a one-on-one interview with Desmond Danso on JoyNews, Ambassador Smith said he is actively engaging investors in the US to sell the opportunities that exist in Ghana. "Now, that is where I am on the other side of the Atlantic asking us to sell the opportunities that exist to the foreign investors. There are big opportunities in mining, energy, agriculture, you name it, manufacturing," he stated. Ambassador Smith encouraged the diaspora to partner with investors. "We're asking our brothers and sisters in the diaspora, you want to come back home, we encourage you, but come in partnership with an investor. He puts his money, he feels secure behind you. You also feel secure because you're not the only one who put your money in there. You create jobs and opportunities for the young people so that our young people, at least, the migration will be minimized," he stated. The Ambassador cited the example of Worcester, Massachusetts, where about 45,000 Ghanaians live. "I went to Worcester in Massachusetts and there are about 45,000 Ghanaians in Worcester alone. And ask me whether they are working. No. They're not. And they are even afraid of their shadows that the eyes will pick them. So, they are spending most of their time in their churches," he stated. "These are not easy things. And I am preaching to them that listen, I'm here to do this. When opportunity strikes, go back home by all means."
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-ambass.title_zh: 加纳驻美国大使维克托·史密斯敦促侨民吸引投资并创造就业
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-ambass.body_zh: 加纳驻美国大使维克托·史密斯敦促加纳侨民携投资者返乡，为年轻人创造就业和机遇。史密斯大使在JoyNews接受德斯蒙德·丹索一对一采访时表示，他正在积极接触美国投资者，推介加纳现有的机遇。他说：“现在，我在大西洋另一端呼吁我们向外国投资者推介这里存在的机遇。采矿、能源、农业、制造业等领域都有巨大机遇，应有尽有。”史密斯大使鼓励侨民与投资者合作。他表示：“我们正在呼吁居住在海外的兄弟姐妹们，如果你们想返乡，我们予以鼓励，但请与投资者合作。他投入资金，就会感到有保障；你们也会感到安心，因为投入资金的不只有你们。这样就能为年轻人创造就业和机遇，至少可以让我们的年轻人减少外出迁移。”大使以马萨诸塞州伍斯特为例，那里有约45,000名加纳人居住。他说：“我去过马萨诸塞州的伍斯特，仅伍斯特一地就有约45,000名加纳人。你问他们有没有工作？没有。他们甚至害怕自己的影子，担心被他人盯上。因此，他们大部分时间都在教堂里度过。”他说：“这些事情并不容易。我也在劝导他们：听着，我来做这件事。机会到来时，一定要回国去。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: The top U.S. envoy to Korea on Monday named alliance modernization, economic ties and regional cooperation as her priorities, saying "trust and communication" are key to achieving them. "None of these things can happen without trust and communication," she said.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 美国驻韩国最高级别特使周一将同盟现代化、经济关系和区域合作列为优先事项，并表示，“信任与沟通”是实现这些目标的关键。她说：“没有信任与沟通，这些事情一件也无法实现。”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: The top U.S. envoy to Korea on Monday named alliance modernization, economic ties and regional cooperation as her priorities, saying "trust and communication" are key to achieving them. U.S. Ambassador Michelle Park Steel made the remarks in a video posted on the embassy's YouTube channel to mark her 100th day in the post. "None of these things can happen without trust and communication," she said. "For more than 70 years, our alliance has helped deter conflict and defend Korea. That remains essential," she said. She also stressed the need to cooperate in adapting to challenges, such as cyber threats and the security implications of new technologies. On Korea's investments in the United States, Steel said it creates jobs and strengthens U.S. industrial capacity while giving Korean companies closer ties with customers and new room to grow. "The U.S. wants to rebuild its shipbuilding capacity and Korean companies have amazing expertise. Working together can strengthen American shipyards and create business opportunities for Korean partners," she said. On batteries, she noted that LG Energy Solution and Samsung SDI have invested in and now manufacture batteries in the U.S. "Demand for energy storage is creating new opportunities for companies helping power American data centers, while supporting American manufacturing and creating jobs on both sides of the Pacific," she said. "There will be opportunities for Korean suppliers, engineers and other businesses," she said. "We should explain those connections clearly and be specific about what each investment will deliver and what Korea will gain."
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 美国最高特使称，信任与沟通是联盟的关键
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 美国驻朝鲜特使周一表示，实现同盟现代化、加强经济联系和深化地区合作是她的优先事项，并称“信任与沟通”是实现这些目标的关键。美国大使朴善娥（Michelle Park Steel）是在使馆YouTube频道发布的一段视频中发表上述言论的，以纪念她任职满100天。她说：“没有信任和沟通，这一切都无法实现。70多年来，我们的同盟帮助遏止了冲突并保卫了朝鲜半岛。这仍然至关重要。”她还强调，需要合作应对各种挑战，包括网络威胁以及新技术带来的安全问题。谈到朝鲜对美国的投资时，朴善娥说，这些投资创造了就业岗位，增强了美国的工业能力，同时让朝鲜半岛的企业与客户建立更紧密的联系，并获得新的增长空间。她说：“美国希望重建其造船能力，而朝鲜半岛的企业拥有令人惊叹的专业技术。携手合作可以增强美国造船厂的能力，并为朝鲜半岛的合作伙伴创造商业机会。”谈到电池时，她指出，LG Energy Solution和Samsung SDI已在美国投资并开始生产电池。她说：“对能源存储的需求正在为帮助美国数据中心供电的企业创造新机遇，同时支持美国制造业，并在太平洋两岸创造就业岗位。朝鲜半岛的供应商、工程师和其他企业将获得机遇。我们应该清楚说明这些联系，并具体说明每项投资将带来什么，以及朝鲜半岛将获得什么。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: A senior North Korean ruling party official's recent visit to Beijing appeared to be intended to share the outcome of last month's key Chinese party meeting and maintain high-level exchanges between the two countries, Seoul's unification ministry said Monday. Yoon Min-ho, the ministry's spokesperson, made the assessment during a press briefing after Kim Song-nam, a member of the Political Bureau of the Workers' Party of Korea and a party secretary, visited China from Tuesday to Saturday, during which he met Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi and other senior officials. "(We) believe that the primary purpose of Kim Song-nam's trip to China this time is to share the results of the fifth plenary session of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and maintain high-level exchanges," Yoon said. "But we will continue monitoring relevant developments with various possibilities in mind," he added. Yoon was responding to a reporter's question about whether the North Korean official's visit was meant for bilateral consultations over the possible resumption of dialogue between Washington and Pyongyang. The spokesperson noted that the North Korean official's trip came just 10 days after North Korean leader Kim Jong-un's visit to the Chinese border city of Dandong, saying the trip showed bilateral relations developing into "strategic" ones. While in China, the North's party official held talks with Liu Haixing, head of the CPC International Department, and Cai Qi, the fifth-ranking member of the CPC. His trip came amid continuing speculation that U.S. President Donald Trump could explore opportunities to resume summitry with the North Korean leader, possibly during his upcoming trip to Asia for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit slated to take place in Shenzhen, China, next week. Commenting on a report that a vice chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly, the North's rubber-stamp parliament, had been dismissed at a presidium meeting Thursday, Yoon said the ministry is monitoring related developments while keeping in mind the possibility that Vice Chairman Ri Son-kwon might have been removed. Ri was thought to have been dismissed as the assembly has two vice chairmen: Kim Hyong-sik and Ri. Kim presided over the meeting last week, according to North Korean state media
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 首尔：朝鲜官员访北京旨在分享中国党的会议成果，维持高层交流
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国统一部周一表示，朝鲜执政党一名高级官员近期访问北京，似乎旨在向中方通报上个月中国共产党重要会议的成果，并维持两国之间的高层交流。统一部发言人尹民浩在记者会上作出上述判断。此前，朝鲜劳动党中央政治局委员、党中央 secretaries 金成南于周二至周六访华，期间会见了中国外交部长王毅及其他高级官员。尹民浩说：“我们认为，金成南此次访华的主要目的，是通报中国共产党中央委员会第五次全体会议的成果，并维持高层交流。”他补充说：“不过，我们仍将考虑各种可能性，继续关注相关动向。”当记者询问朝鲜官员此次来访是否旨在就华盛顿与平壤可能恢复对话举行双边磋商时，尹民浩作出上述回应。他说，朝鲜官员此行发生在朝鲜领导人金正恩访问中国边境城市丹东仅10天之后，表明双边关系正发展为“战略”关系。在中国期间，这名朝鲜党政官员与中共中央对外工作部部长刘海兴以及中共中央政治局委员、中共中央书记处书记蔡奇举行了会谈。此行之际，外界持续猜测，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普可能会寻求机会恢复与朝鲜领导人举行峰会，或许就在他下周赴亚洲出席计划于中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会期间。尹民浩在评论一则关于朝鲜最高人民会议常任委员会委员于周四主席会议上被免职的报道时表示，统一部正在关注相关动向，同时考虑副主席李善权可能已被免职的可能性。外界认为李善权可能已被免职，因为该会议设有两副主席，分别是金亨植和李善权。据朝鲜官方媒体报道，金正恩上周主持了此次会议。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Late Chairman Cho Suck-rai recognized for decades of Korea-US economic diplomacy Late Hyosung Group Honorary Chairman Cho Suck-rai has been posthumously awarded the Korea-America Friendship Award in recognition of his decades-long efforts to strengthen economic ties between Korea and the United States.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 已故董事长赵锡来获表彰，以肯定其数十年来为加强韩国与美国经济关系所作的努力；晚星集团荣誉董事长赵锡来被追授韩美友谊奖。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Late Chairman Cho Suck-rai recognized for decades of Korea-US economic diplomacy Late Hyosung Group Honorary Chairman Cho Suck-rai has been posthumously awarded the Korea-America Friendship Award in recognition of his decades-long efforts to strengthen economic ties between Korea and the United States. The group said that the late chairman received the 24th annual award from the Korea-America Association (KAA) at its ceremony on Monday in Seoul, with his son, Hyosung Chairman Cho Hyun-joon, accepting the award on his behalf. The association recognized Cho Suck-rai for his efforts to strengthen bilateral economic ties, particularly his role in rallying business support for the free trade agreement between Korea and the U.S. and helping secure Korea's entry into the U.S. Visa Waiver Program. Accepting the award, Cho Hyun-joon expressed gratitude on behalf of his family, noting that his grandfather, former KAA Chairman Song In-sang, had received the same honor in 2004. "It is deeply meaningful to see that my father's lifelong wish for a Korea-U.S. alliance in which the two countries understand each other and grow together is becoming a reality today," He said. "I will keep his legacy close to my heart and do my utmost to ensure that the Korea-U.S. alliance remains strong for future generations." The late chairman was widely regarded as one of Korea’s leading private-sector diplomats, drawing on his foreign language skills, extensive overseas business experience and global network to advance the country's economic interests abroad. He served as chairman of the business think tank Pacific Basin Economic Council in 2002 and subsequently held leadership positions at major business organizations, including the Federation of Korean Industries, the U.S.-Korea Business Council (USKBC) and the Korea-Japan Economic Association. One of his most significant contributions was helping lay the groundwork for the Korea-U.S. Free Trade Agreement (KORUS FTA). While serving as chairman of the Korean side of USKBC in 2000, the late chairman became the first Korean business leader to publicly advocate a bilateral FTA, arguing that trade liberalization was essential to integrating the country’s economy into global markets. He led joint research initiatives between business communities in the two countries and worked to build support for formal negotiations in 2006. Cho Suck-rai remained involved throughout the negotiating process, meeting with government officials, lawmakers and business leaders on both sides to build consensus and help overcome disagreements. He also helped mediate tensions surrounding Washington's demand for Korea to reduce its screen quota, which required local theaters to show domestic films for a certain number of days each year. The issue had become a major obstacle to negotiations, amid opposition from the Korean film industry. After the two sides reached an agreement in 2007, he continued lobbying efforts, traveling to Washington in 2007 to urge U.S. lawmakers to ratify the deal. The late chairman also played a key role in securing Korea's inclusion in the U.S. Visa Waiver Program in 2008, which allows eligible Koreans to visit the U.S. for tourism or business for up to 90 days without obtaining a visa. He argued that closer economic ties required the free movement of people as well as goods. He also sent a letter directly to the U.S. secretary of state urging Korea's inclusion in the program and established a dedicated visa subcommittee within the USKBC to coordinate efforts. Beyond his bilateral activities, Cho Suck-rai contributed to expanding Korea's presence in the global business community through his leadership in international economic organizations. He received the Gold Tower Order of Industrial Service Merit, the highest state honor bestowed on business leaders, in 1987. He also received awards recognizing his contributions to the 10th anniversary of the KORUS FTA and the Lee Hong-koo Diplomacy Award, formerly known as the Youngsan Diplomat Award. The Korea-America Friendship Award has been presented annually by the KAA since 2002 to individuals who have made significant contributions to promoting friendship and strengthening ties between the two countries. Past recipients include Horace Underwood, the former president of Yonsei University, retired Army Gen. Paik Sun-yup, former U.N. Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon and Chung Se-yung, former honorary chairman of Hyundai Development Company. About 300 people from Korea and the U.S., including U.S. Ambassador to Korea Michelle Steel, attended the ceremony
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 已故晓星会长获颁韩美友好奖
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 已故董事长赵锡来获表彰，以肯定其数十年来推动韩美经济外交的贡献 已故晓星集团名誉董事长赵锡来被追授韩美友谊奖，以表彰他数十年来为加强韩国与美国经济关系所作的努力。集团表示，已故董事长于周一在首尔举行的仪式上从韩美协会（KAA）领取第24届年度奖项，其儿子晓星集团董事长赵显俊代为领奖。协会表彰赵锡来加强双边经济关系的努力，尤其肯定他在争取商界支持韩美自由贸易协定以及帮助韩国加入美国免签证计划方面发挥的作用。赵显俊代全家领奖并表达感谢，同时指出，他的祖父、 韩美协会前董事长宋仁相曾于2004年获得同一奖项。他说：“看到父亲毕生希望两国相互理解、共同发展的韩美同盟如今成为现实，意义深远。我会将他的精神传承铭记于心，并尽最大努力确保韩美同盟为子孙后代保持强大。”已故董事长被广泛视为韩国leading民间外交人物之一，凭借外语能力、丰富的海外从商经历和全球人脉，推动韩国经济利益走向海外。他于2002年担任经济智库太平洋盆地经济理事会主席，随后在韩国商工联合会、韩美商务理事会（USKBC）和韩日经济协会等重要商界机构担任领导职务。他最重要的贡献之一，是帮助为韩美自由贸易协定（KORUS FTA）奠定基础。2000年担任USKBC韩方主席期间，已故董事长成为首位公开主张缔结双边自由贸易协定的韩国商界领袖，认为贸易自由化是将韩国经济融入全球市场的必要条件。他推动两国商界开展联合研究，并为2006年的正式谈判争取支持。在整个谈判过程中，赵锡来持续参与，与两国政府官员、议员和商界领袖会面，以凝聚共识并帮助化解分歧。他还协助调解围绕华盛顿要求韩国减少银幕配额所产生的紧张局势。该要求规定当地影院每年须在一定天数内放映国产电影；在韩国电影业反对的情况下，此事一度成为谈判的主要障碍。2007年双方达成协议后，他继续开展游说工作，于2007年前往华盛顿，敦促美国议员批准协议。已故董事长还在推动韩国于2008年加入美国免签证计划方面发挥关键作用。该计划允许符合条件的韩国人以旅游或商务为目的赴美停留最长90天，无需办理签证。他主张，更紧密的经济关系不仅需要商品自由流通，也需要人员自由流动。他还直接致信美国国务卿，敦促将韩国纳入该计划，并在USKBC内设立专门的签证分委员会，以协调相关工作。除双边活动外，赵锡来还通过在国际经济组织中担任领导职务，推动韩国扩大在全球商界的影响力。1987年，他获颁工业服务功勋金塔勋章，这是授予商界领袖的国家最高荣誉。他还获得了表彰其为韩美自由贸易协定签署10周年所作贡献的奖项，以及李洪圭外交奖，该奖原名永山外交奖。自2002年起，韩美协会每年颁发韩美友谊奖，表彰对促进两国友谊和加强关系作出重大贡献的个人。历届获奖者包括延世大学前校长霍勒斯·安德伍德、退役陆军上将白善燁、联合国前秘书长潘基文，以及 Hyundai Development Company前名誉董事长郑世永。来自韩国和美国的约300人参加了典礼，其中包括美国驻韩大使米歇尔·斯蒂尔。

An earlier version of the bill, introduced by the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) in April, would have allowed the special counsel to take over pending prosecutions and decide whether to maintain them, prompting opposition accusations that it was designed to clear Lee of criminal charges.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 国民议会周五通过的特别检察官法引发了利益冲突方面的疑问，也让人质疑其调查权限是否符合政府的检察改革要求。该法案的早期版本由执政的朝鲜民主主义劳动党（DPK）于4月提出，原本将允许特别检察官接手尚未结案的刑事诉讼，并决定是否继续审理，从而引发反对党指控，称该法案旨在洗清李在明所面临的刑事指控。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: A special counsel law passed by the National Assembly on Friday is drawing questions over conflicts of interest and whether its investigative powers are consistent with the government’s prosecution reforms. The legislation calls for an investigation into allegations that prosecutors and other state agencies fabricated evidence or brought politically motivated charges under former President Yoon Suk Yeol. Its 12 areas of investigation include cases involving President Lee Jae Myung, including alleged election law violations, involvement in development scandals and illicit money transfers to North Korea. An earlier version of the bill, introduced by the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) in April, would have allowed the special counsel to take over pending prosecutions and decide whether to maintain them, prompting opposition accusations that it was designed to clear Lee of criminal charges. The DPK came up with a revised version after Lee asked lawmakers in September to remove the provision. But the appointment process remains contentious. Three parties — the DPK, the main opposition People Power Party and the minor liberal Rebuilding Korea Party — can nominate a candidate, with Lee making the final choice. Critics say the president would thus select the person who can find possible misconduct in prosecutions involving him. Although the investigation would not directly annul indictments against Lee, even if prosecutorial misconduct is found, its findings could affect his pending cases that will resume after his term ends. The DPK counters that a special counsel operates independently once appointed and is not subject to presidential direction. Another dispute centers on prosecutors’ investigative authority. Revised criminal procedure rules that took effect in October removed ordinary prosecutors’ direct investigative powers. Yet Article 6 of the special counsel law’s supplementary provisions applies the previous rules to the special counsel and dispatched prosecutors. “Applying an old law that is no longer in force to a special counsel investigation raises constitutional and legal problems,” Cho Kuk, head of the Rebuilding Korea Party’s policy institute, wrote Friday on Facebook. “Even if prosecutors with investigative experience are needed to examine fabricated investigations, prosecutors are no longer investigative authorities,” he wrote, warning that a court challenge over constitutionality could halt proceedings. DPK Rep. Kim Han-kyu rejected the criticism. “When the Criminal Procedure Act was revised, its supplementary provisions already stipulated that special counsels and dispatched prosecutors retain investigative powers under the previous law,” he told reporters. “This bill merely repeats that provision, so there is nothing unconstitutional or unlawful about it.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 特别检察官调查方案引发合宪性与利益冲突质疑
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 国民议会于星期五通过的一项特别检察官法案引发了人们对利益冲突的质疑，也使人关注其调查权限是否与政府的检察改革相一致。该法案要求调查前总统尹锡悦任内，检方及其他国家机构伪造证据或提出出于政治目的的指控等指控。其调查范围包括12个方面，涉及总统李在明相关的案件，包括涉嫌违反选举法、卷入开发丑闻以及向朝鲜非法转移资金等。该法案的早期版本由执政的韩国民主党的（DPK）于4月提出，原本允许特别检察官接管尚未审结的案件，并决定是否继续进行诉讼，从而引发反对党指责，称该法案旨在洗清李在明面临的刑事指控。在李在明于9月要求议员删除相关条款后，民主党提出了修订版本。但特别检察官的任命程序仍存在争议。三个政党——民主党、主要反对党国民力量党以及较小的自由主义重建韩国党——均可提名候选人，最终由李在明决定人选。批评者称，这意味着总统将挑选一名能够调查与其本人相关起诉中可能存在的不当行为的人。尽管调查不会直接撤销对李在明的起诉，即便认定检方存在不当行为，调查结果仍可能影响其任期结束后恢复审理的未决案件。民主党则反驳称，特别检察官一经任命便独立运作，不受总统指挥。另一项争议聚焦于检方的调查权限。10月生效的修订版刑事诉讼法规则取消了普通检察官直接开展调查的权力。然而，特别检察官法附则第6条规定，适用原有规则对特别检察官和派遣检察官进行授权。重建韩国党政策研究所负责人赵 Kuk 星期五在 Facebook 上写道：“将已经失效的旧法适用于特别检察官调查，会引发宪法和法律问题。他说：“即使审查伪造调查需要具备调查经验的检察官，检察官如今也不再是调查机关，”并警告称，针对该规定合宪性的法庭审查可能中止程序。民主党议员金汉圭驳斥了这些批评。他对记者表示：“《刑事诉讼法》修订时，其附则已经明确规定，特别检察官和派遣检察官依照旧法保留调查权。该法案只是重申这一规定，因此不存在违宪或违法之处。”

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nasa.body: The Nasarawa State Government has reaffirmed its commitment to conducting free, fair, transparent and peaceful elections, warning individuals and groups planning to instigate violence that they will be arrested and prosecuted. The State Commissioner for Information, Culture and Tourism, Dr. Nawani Aboki, gave the assurance while addressing journalists, stakeholders, party supporters and government partners in Lafia on Monday. Aboki said the government was monitoring the security situation across the state’s local government areas to ensure that voters could exercise their franchise without fear or intimidation. Warning those contemplating violence, the commissioner said the government’s preference for peace should not be mistaken for weakness. “Quietness does not mean that somebody is weak. At times, when someone is pushed, the time comes when they must act. “Anyone who wants to perpetuate violence will be arrested and prosecuted to ensure we have peaceful elections,” he warned. He urged political parties and candidates to conduct their campaigns in an orderly and civilised manner, stressing that political violence would serve no useful purpose in the electoral process or the development of the state. On voter participation, Aboki urged eligible residents to ensure their Permanent Voter Cards (PVCs) were ready and safely kept ahead of the elections. He advised voters against waiting until election day to collect their PVCs and encouraged those yet to register to take advantage of the online voter registration platform. Highlighting infrastructure and social development projects undertaken by the Federal Government and the administration of Governor Abdullahi Sule, the commissioner cited the proposed transformation of the Federal Polytechnic, Nasarawa, into a specialised mining university, as well as the Leather Designing and Craft School in Doma. On infrastructure, he listed the ongoing federal government dualisation and expansion of the Nasarawa-Keffi road network and the Akwanga-Jos-Bauchi-Gombe Superhighway among projects expected to improve connectivity. In the health sector, Aboki said the upgrading and expansion of the Dalhatu Araf Specialist Hospital into the Federal University Teaching Hospital, Lafia, alongside facilities such as the Federal Eye Centre in Doma, had improved access to healthcare. The commissioner called on residents to support the All Progressives Congress (APC) gubernatorial candidate and other party candidates, arguing that such support would sustain the development initiatives of the Sule administration. “I know all of us are happy with the work Governor Sule has done. And so he has given us somebody we need to support. I want to call on all of us, and indeed the people of Nasarawa State, to support the candidate he has given us,” he said. He expressed the hope that the candidate would build on the achievements of the incumbent administration and deliver further development. Aboki also called for support for Governor Sule’s senatorial ambition, saying his performance in Akwanga zone deserved recognition. “He has done so much for the Akwanga zone, and I think the area should show gratitude and elect him as Senator for that particular zone,” he added. The commissioner said the Sule administration remained open to dialogue and constructive feedback from citizens and development partners to advance its development objectives. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nasa.title_zh: 纳萨拉瓦州承诺选举和平，警告勿实施选举暴力
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nasa.body_zh: 纳萨拉瓦州政府再次承诺举行自由、公平、透明和和平的选举，并警告任何策划煽动暴力的人员和团体，他们将被逮捕和起诉。纳萨拉瓦州信息、文化和旅游委员会委员纳瓦尼·阿博基博士周一在拉菲亚对记者、利益相关方、政党支持者和政府合作伙伴作出上述保证。阿博基表示，政府正在监测全州各地方政府的治安局势，以确保选民能够不受恐惧或威胁地行使选举权。委员警告那些意图实施暴力的人称，政府对和平的重视不应被误认为软弱。“安静并不意味着某人软弱。有时，当一个人受到逼迫时，采取行动的时候就到了。“任何企图延续暴力的人都将被逮捕和起诉，以确保我们举行和平选举。”他警告说。他敦促各政党和候选人以有序和文明的方式开展竞选活动，强调政治暴力对选举进程或州的发展都不会有任何益处。在选民参与方面，阿博基敦促符合条件的居民确保在选举前备妥并妥善保管永久选民卡（PVC）。他建议选民不要等到选举日才去领取永久选民卡，并鼓励尚未登记的选民利用在线选民登记平台。他提到联邦政府和州长阿卜杜拉希·苏莱政府实施的基础设施和社会发展项目，并列举了将纳萨拉瓦联邦理工学院改建成专业化矿业大学以及在多马建设皮革设计与工艺学校的计划。在基础设施方面，他列举了联邦政府正在推进的纳萨拉瓦—凯菲公路网升级改造和扩建工程，以及阿宽加—乔斯—博奇—贡贝高速公路，这些项目预计将改善交通连接。在医疗卫生领域，阿博基表示，将达尔哈图·阿拉法夫专科医院升级扩建为拉菲亚联邦大学教学医院，并完善多马联邦眼科中心等设施，改善了医疗服务可及性。委员呼吁居民支持全进步大会党（APC）州长候选人及该党其他候选人，认为这种支持将延续苏莱政府的发展举措。“我知道我们所有人都对苏莱州长所做的工作感到满意。因此，他为我们选出了我们需要支持的人。我要呼吁我们所有人，以及纳萨拉瓦州的民众，支持他为我们选出的候选人。”他说。他希望候选人能在现任政府的成就基础上继续推进工作，并推动进一步发展。阿博基还呼吁支持苏莱州长竞选联邦参议员，称他在阿宽加地区的政绩值得认可。“他为阿宽加地区做出了巨大贡献，我认为该地区应表达谢意，选举他担任该地区的联邦参议员。”他补充说。委员表示，苏莱政府仍愿与公民及发展伙伴开展对话，接收建设性反馈，以推进其发展目标。此处发表的意见不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.myjoyonline.com/trump-says-i.body: US President Donald Trump has said his immigration crackdown was "too tough", marking one of his clearest public retreats from a defining plank of his political agenda, following his party's drubbing in the midterm elections. In an interview with CBS' 60 Minutes programme, Trump said he believed he deserved an "A plus" for drastically limiting illegal border crossings, but he had been politically "hurt" by sweeping deportations. His acknowledgement came despite his homeland security department insisting it was not backing away from the crackdown. Election day polling indicated immigration was the third most important issue for midterm voters, after the economy and the state of democracy. In historically conservative states like Texas, a swing of Latino voters towards Democrats helped seal the Democratic Party's landslide majorities in Congress. The president told 60 Minutes that immigration "both helped and hurt" his fellow Republicans in Tuesday's midterms. "I think I got an A plus for closing up the border," he said in the programme that aired on Sunday evening. He added: "For getting people out, I get very high marks for getting the bad ones out. Trump also said he'd "love to do something on immigration" with congressional Democrats, without offering details. In a previous interview with 60 Minutes a year ago, a defiant Trump insisted his administraiton's immigration raids "haven't gone far enough". His conciliatory words on Sunday were an abrupt change in tone from a White House statement earlier in the day to the BBC. A spokeswoman vowed "the administration will not slow down its efforts to arrest and deport criminal illegal aliens who terrorise our communities". The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) also showed no sign of a U-turn on Sunday. "ICE is NOT backing away or slowing down," a DHS spokesperson told the BBC. Following Tuesday's electoral losses, Vice-President JD Vance had appeared receptive to adjusting their immigration strategy. "I'm open to the idea that we should change enforcement - by focusing more on businesses that hire illegal labour, for instance," Vance wrote in a lengthy online post reflecting on the results. However, Trump's promotion on Friday of immigration hawk Stephen Miller to White House chief of staff signalled no climbdown from the administration. Miller is widely seen as the architect of the administration's hardline immigration policy during the first and second Trump presidencies. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) sources told CBS that in recent weeks officials have been instructed to aim for about 2,700 arrests of illegal immigrants per day, an increase from an earlier 2,000 daily arrest target. Enforcement sweeps this year spurred anti-ICE demonstrations in cities including Chicago, Minneapolis and Los Angeles. In Minneapolis, two US protesters, Renee Good and Alex Pretti, were fatally shot by immigration agents
https://www.myjoyonline.com/trump-says-i.title_zh: 特朗普称打击移民行动“过于严厉”，并称其在中期选举失利中起了作用
https://www.myjoyonline.com/trump-says-i.body_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，他的移民政策打击行动“力度过大”，这是其政党在中期选举中惨败后，他公开背离政治议程核心支柱之一的最明确表现之一。特朗普在接受 CBS《60 分钟》节目采访时表示，他认为自己大幅减少非法越境行为理应获得“A+”的评价，但大规模驱逐行动令他在政治上“受到伤害”。尽管他的国土安全部坚称不会放松移民政策打击行动，他仍作出了这一表态。选举日民调显示，移民问题是中期选举选民最关心的第三大问题，仅次于经济和民主状况。在得克萨斯州等历来倾向保守的州，拉丁裔选民转向民主党，帮助民主党在国会赢得了压倒性多数席位。特朗普在周日晚间播出的《60 分钟》节目中告诉主持人，移民问题在周二的期中选举中“既帮了共和党人，也害了共和党人”。他说：“我认为，我因关闭边境而获得了 A+ 的评价。”他还补充道：“在把人送走方面，我因把那些坏人送走而获得了很高的分数。”特朗普还表示，他“很愿意在移民问题上与国会民主党人采取一些行动”，但没有透露具体细节。在一年前接受《60 分钟》采访时，态度强硬的特朗普坚称，其政府的移民突袭行动“力度还不够”。周日的缓和言辞与白宫当天早些时候向 BBC 发布声明时的强硬语气截然不同。一名女发言人承诺：“政府不会放缓逮捕和驱逐那些恐吓我们社区的犯罪非法移民的努力。”国土安全部（DHS）周日的表态也没有显示会改变政策。DHS 发言人对 BBC 表示：“ICE 绝没有退缩，也不会放缓行动。”在周二的选举失利后，副总统 JD·万斯曾表示愿意考虑调整移民战略。万斯在一篇回顾选举结果的长篇网络帖文中写道：“我愿意考虑我们是否应该改变执法重点，例如更多地关注雇用非法劳工的企业。”然而，特朗普周五将移民鹰派人物斯蒂芬·米勒提拔为白宫幕僚长，这表明政府没有退让迹象。外界普遍认为，在特朗普第一和第二任总统任期内，米勒是政府强硬移民政策的设计者。CBS 从移民与海关执法局（ICE）获得的消息称，近几周来，官员接到指示，每天目标是逮捕约 2,700 名非法移民，高于此前每日逮捕 2,000 人的目标。今年的执法行动引发了包括芝加哥、明尼阿波利斯和洛杉矶在内的多座城市的反 ICE 示威。在明尼阿波利斯，两名美国示威者 Renee Good 和 Alex Pretti 被移民执法人员开枪致命击中……

https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/0.summary_zh: 在标语写着“特朗普滚出去！”“特朗普现在就滚出去！”和“抵制美国主导的战争！”的横幅引导下，示威者于11月9日星期一在马尼拉的Kalaw Avenue游行，抗议美国总统计划出席第49届东盟峰会。为表达象征性的拒绝，数名抗议者用扫帚将特朗普的画像沿街扫走，其他人则跟在他们身后游行。
https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/0.body: Carrying banners reading "Trump Out!", "Trump Out Now!" and "Resist US-Led Wars!", demonstrators marched along Kalaw Avenue in Manila on Monday 9 November against the US president's planned visit for the 49th ASEAN Summit . In a symbolic rejection, several protesters swept images of Trump along the road with brooms while others marched behind them. "Let's reject the visit of Donald Trump. Let's not welcome him as a guest of honour," one demonstrator said in Tagalog. The rally, led by the women's group Gabriela , came days before the summit, which Manila hosts in mid-November and which the White House and Malacañang have confirmed Trump will attend , his first visit since 2017. Beyond opposing the visit, protesters demanded the scrapping of Pax Silica , the US-led pact on secure supply chains for semiconductors, critical minerals and AI, which the Philippines joined in April 2026 as its 13th signatory. Its centrepiece is a proposed 4,000-acre hub in New Clark City, Tarlac, which activists say serves US interests over Filipino ones. "We are rejecting this framework as it does not prioritise the interest of the Filipino people," one participant told AFP. Gabriela also called for the Visiting Forces Agreement to be scrapped

https://www.inquirer.net/495039/chinese-.summary_zh: 当地渔民要求拆除数百个养鱼网箱。他们称，这些网箱占据了卡巴利蒂安村的卡尔帕伊浅滩当地居民世代赖以维生的水域。卡巴利蒂安渔民表示，中国运营商此前将作业范围限定在苏阿尔海水养殖区，那里设有数千个养鱼网箱。
https://www.inquirer.net/495039/chinese-.body: Local fishermen are demanding the removal of hundreds of fish cages that they said have occupied Calpay Shoal in Barangay Cabalitian, where generations of residents have made their living. They accused workers of the Chinese operators of driving them away from the waters where their families have fished for generations, forcing them to sail to nearby coastal towns. The Cabalitian fishermen said the Chinese operators previously confined their operations to the Sual Mariculture Zone, where thousands of fish cages are located. However, allegedly due to water pollution in the mariculture zone, the operators began transferring their cages to Calpay Shoal in Cabitaogan Bay off Cabalitian Island, said Nicasio Abata, 80, leader of the Small Fisherfolk and Stakeholders of Cabalitian. In an interview with the Inquirer on Saturday (November 7), Abata said 99 fish cage structures had been transferred from the mariculture zone before May 2026, followed by another 33 shortly afterward. “They have no permission from the barangay or the local government to transfer to Calpay Shoal, making their operations illegal,” Abata said. The Sual Municipal Agriculture Office also said it had not issued any permit or authorization for the placement of fish cages in the shoal. “The unmitigated operations of these illegal structures have restricted the traditional fishing grounds of marginalized local fishermen, caused severe ecological degradation, and directly threatened the marine biodiversity of the sea,” the Cabalitian fishermen said in a petition submitted to various government agencies. /mcm

https://leadership.ng/gov-eno-lauds-deep.summary: LEADERSHIP learnt that after a series of overtures to the Presidency for the final approval, the governor had to beg the President on his working visit to the state at the weekend, to calm the frayed nerves of the anxious citizens by making the pronouncement himself. But it turned to be a political gambit, as the President, used the opportunity to also bargain in a Seaport – For -Vote Deal as a political concession, where he personally negotiated for votes before making the pronouncement.
https://leadership.ng/gov-eno-lauds-deep.summary_zh: 领导层了解到，在多次请求总统最终批准后，州长不得不在周末总统对州进行工作访问时向总统恳求，由总统亲自作出这项宣布，以安抚焦虑不安、紧张不安的公民。但事实证明，这是一种政治策略：总统借机把海港建设换取选票的交易也纳入其中，作为政治让步；他亲自争取选票，之后才作出宣布。
https://leadership.ng/gov-eno-lauds-deep.body: LEADERSHIP learnt that after a series of overtures to the Presidency for the final approval, the governor had to beg the President on his working visit to the state at the weekend, to calm the frayed nerves of the anxious citizens by making the pronouncement himself. But it turned to be a political gambit, as the President, used the opportunity to also bargain in a Seaport – For -Vote Deal as a political concession, where he personally negotiated for votes before making the pronouncement. “Will you vote for me?, the President thundered, adding: “if you vote for me, then the Seaport is yours,” he assured. Therefore, the elated crowd that thonged the Godswill Akpabio International Stadium (Nest of Champions), replied in the affirmative, with a guarantee of 2 million votes. However, in appreciating the gesture, the Governor, on Sunday, took to the radio in a State – wide broadcast -to show immense thanks to the President for the gesture, which LEADERSHIP gathered, had put him under pressure by the citizens since assuming office in 2023. “On behalf of the Government and people of Akwa Ibom State, together with the Senate President of the Federal Republic of Nigeria and his dear wife, we sincerely thank Mr President for honouring us with his esteemed presence and more importantly, for his landmark approval of the financing arrangements for the Ibom Deep Sea Port Project. “This approval marks a defining moment in our State’s economic journey. The Ibom Deep Sea Port is not just an infrastructure project; it is a gateway to economic transformation, international trade, investments, industrial growth and employment opportunities for our people. “It will reposition Akwa Ibom as a major economic and maritime hub in Nigeria and the Gulf of Guinea. We are grateful to Mr President for his confidence in our State and his commitment to the development of our Nation. We assure him of our full cooperation to ensure the successful realisation of this historic project. “Mr. President, to whom much is given, much is also required. Akwa Ibom assures you that we will respond enmasse on January 16, 2027, as we will give you all our votes in support of your continuity in office from May 29,2027. “My dear Akwa Ibomites, let me at this point express my profound appreciation to you for the overwhelming reception and extraordinary hospitality extended to Mr President and his team. “The massive turnout of all our people, the support groups, the various committees, the executive council members, our critical stakeholders to receive the President, was indeed overwhelming. You have once again shown that Akwa Ibom is a peaceful, welcoming and investment-ready State. “I thank our traditional rulers, religious leaders, political stakeholders, youths, women, security agencies, public servants, students, and everyone who contributed to the success of this historic visit. “Once again, I thank Mr President for his visit and his support for the Ibom Deep Sea Port project,” Gov Eno said in the rare broadcast. https://leadership.ng/gov-eno-lauds-deep.title_zh: 埃诺州州长赞扬廷努布批准建设深海港
https://leadership.ng/gov-eno-lauds-deep.body_zh:
领导层获知，在为争取最终批准而多次向总统府提出请求后，州长不得不在周末总统对该州进行工作访问时向总统求情，请总统亲自宣布此事，以安抚 anxious citizens 紧绷的情绪。但事实证明，这是一种政治策略。总统利用这个机会，将一揽子“港口换选票”协议作为政治让步进行讨价还价，在宣布决定之前亲自争取选票。总统雷厉风行地说道：“你们会投我一票吗？如果你们投我一票，港口就归你们。”他这样保证道。因此，挤满 Godswill Akpabio International Stadium（冠军摇篮）的人群兴奋不已，表示愿意投票，并保证提供200万张选票。不过，州长对这一姿态深表感激，并于周日通过全州广播向总统致以诚挚谢意。领导层获悉，自2023年就任以来，民众一直因此事给州长施压。州长说：“我谨代表阿夸伊博姆州政府及人民，以及尼日利亚联邦共和国参议院议长和他亲爱的妻子，衷心感谢总统先生莅临我们这里，更重要的是感谢他对 Ibom Deep Sea Port 项目融资安排作出具有里程碑意义的批准。

“这一批准标志着我们州经济发展历程中的一个重要转折点。Ibom Deep Sea Port 不仅仅是一个基础设施项目；它是实现经济转型、发展国际贸易、吸引投资、推动工业增长和为民众创造就业机会的门户。

“它将使阿夸伊博姆成为尼日利亚和几内亚湾重要的经济及海运中心。我们感谢总统先生对我们州的信心，以及他对我国发展的承诺。我们保证全力配合，确保这一历史性项目顺利实现。

“总统先生，您获得了很多，也就需要承担更多。阿夸伊博姆向您保证，我们将在2027年1月16日集体作出回应，把全部选票投给您，支持您自2027年5月29日起继续执政。

“亲爱的阿夸伊博姆同胞们，此时此刻，我想向你们表达诚挚的感谢，感谢你们热情接待总统先生及其团队，并给予其非凡的款待。

“我们全体民众、支持团体、各委员会、行政委员会成员以及各个重要利益相关方踊跃 turnout 迎接总统，场面确实热烈非凡。你们再次证明，阿夸伊博姆是一个和平、热情欢迎投资且已做好投资准备的州。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title: Does Korea need midterm elections?
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: Single presidential tenure with National Assembly election on its own calendar makes midterm assessment more difficult The 2026 U.S. midterm elections delivered a sweeping rebuke to President Donald Trump. Korea has regular elections that can serve as midterm tests, but no guaranteed presidential midterm. To create a guaranteed midterm check, Korea would also need to arrange for a separate election — most plausibly a National Assembly election — to fall at a defined point during the presidential term.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 总统任期单独计算，而国民议会选举则另有时间安排，这让中期评估更加困难。2026年美国中期选举对唐纳德·特朗普总统造成了全面否定。韩国定期举行选举，可充当中期检验，但没有确定在总统任期中期举行的选举。若要建立有保障的中期制衡机制，韩国还须另行安排一场选举——最有可能的是国民议会选举——并将其固定在总统任期内的特定时间举行。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: Single presidential tenure with National Assembly election on its own calendar makes midterm assessment more difficult The 2026 U.S. midterm elections delivered a sweeping rebuke to President Donald Trump. Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress, flipping Senate seats even in Republican strongholds such as Texas, Kansas and South Carolina. The night also brought historic firsts such as the first Muslim and the first openly gay man elected to the U.S. Senate. Voters were passing judgment on Trump’s performance. Many blamed his policies for the high cost of living. The Iran war added to their frustration, through higher fuel prices and doubts about the decision to enter the conflict. Aggressive immigration enforcement was another visible and divisive part of his agenda. No single issue explains the result, but the election gave Americans a chance to voice their discontent and to change who controls Congress. Watching the results from New York, I found myself thinking about how differently Korea delivered its own verdict on a president not long ago. When then-President Yoon Suk Yeol declared martial law in December 2024, citizens rushed to the National Assembly as lawmakers moved swiftly to reject the order. Months of powerful yet peaceful mass protests followed, and Yoon was ultimately removed from office. Of course, the two cases are not equivalent. One was an extraordinary effort to defend constitutional government from an immediate threat. The other was a routine election that shifted the balance of power. But together they show that democratic resilience takes different forms: citizens filling a public square, legislators refusing an unlawful order, voters using the ballot box to constrain a government. Democracies need more than one way for people to hold power to account. Protest is an essential democratic right. When institutions are under threat, public assembly shows that people will not accept the erosion of their rights in silence. But protest cannot carry the whole burden of accountability. The U.S. midterm elections matter because they give citizens a regular, consequential opportunity to judge a government while it is still in office. It is not simply a date on the calendar; it is a constitutional choice about when the public gets its say. Korea has regular elections that can serve as midterm tests, but no guaranteed presidential midterm. Because the presidential term is a single, nonrenewable five years and the National Assembly term is four, general elections fall at a different point in each presidency. In April 2024, about two years into Yoon’s term, voters handed the opposition a landslide, a midterm rebuke in all but name. Under President Lee Jae Myung, the next general election will not come until April 2028, three years into his term. This June’s elections offered voters an early chance to assess Lee’s administration, but they came just one year into his presidency and were shaped mostly by local candidates and concerns, even when national politics loomed large. Korea’s check exists, but its timing is left to the arithmetic of the calendar. Lee has advocated a constitutional amendment to introduce a U.S.-style, four-year presidency with the possibility of a second term, arguing that it would allow a “midterm evaluation” of the administration. A renewable term would give voters a chance to approve or reject a president at the next presidential election. But that election would come at the end of a term, not halfway through it. To create a guaranteed midterm check, Korea would also need to arrange for a separate election — most plausibly a National Assembly election — to fall at a defined point during the presidential term. Together, these changes could strengthen accountability. An incumbent seeking reelection would have to win voters’ approval again, and a scheduled election during the term would give the public an earlier chance to reward or rebuke the government. That might make presidents more attentive to how their policies affect people. It would also give citizens a peaceful, predictable outlet for frustration. There are real risks, too. More frequent national campaigning could deepen polarization, encourage short-term decision-making and leave governments in near-permanent election mode. Local contests might become even more dominated by national battles. And constitutional change is no technical fix. It would require approval by at least two-thirds of the National Assembly and a national referendum, as well as durable public consensus about how the new election schedule should work. Korea does not have to copy the U.S. system to learn from its underlying idea: People should not have to wait until the end of a president’s term to deliver their verdict. Protest, the courts, the National Assembly and elections each serve different purposes. A well-designed midterm could add another democratic check, but no calendar can guarantee accountability on its own. Korea’s recent history makes the point. In 2024, voters delivered a clear midterm verdict on Yoon. Eight months later, he declared martial law against an opposition-controlled Assembly. This week, even Trump, who never conceded his 2020 loss, said he would accept the midterm results. The value of any midterm depends not only on whether it gives citizens a real choice, but on whether political leaders accept the result. Min Seong-jae (smin@pace.edu) is a professor of communication and media studies at Pace University in New York
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 总统单一任期与国民议会选举各自按照自己的时间表进行，使得中期评估更加困难。2026年美国中期选举对唐纳德·特朗普总统作出了全面否定。民主党人赢得国会两院控制权，甚至在得克萨斯州、堪萨斯州和南卡罗来纳州等共和党 stronghold 翻转了参议院席位。当晚还出现了历史性首次，例如首位穆斯林和首位公开出柜同性恋男性当选美国参议员。选民是在评价特朗普的施政表现。许多人把生活成本高企归咎于他的政策。伊朗战争通过推高燃油价格，以及引发人们对决定参战的疑虑，加剧了他们的不满。激进移民执法是他议程中另一项显眼且引发分歧的内容。没有任何单一议题能够解释这一结果，但这次选举给了美国人表达不满并改变国会控制权归属的机会。从纽约看到选举结果时，我不禁想到，韩国不久前以多么不同的方式对一位总统作出了裁决。2024年12月，时任总统尹锡悦宣布戒严时，民众涌向国民议会，议员迅速行动起来否决该命令。随后发生了持续数月、力量强大但保持和平的大规模抗议，尹锡悦最终被免职。当然，这两个案例并不等同。一个是为抵御迫在眉睫的威胁而捍卫宪政的非凡行动，另一个则是改变权力平衡的例行选举。但两者共同表明，民主的韧性有不同表现形式：民众填满公共广场，议员拒绝非法命令，选民利用投票箱约束政府。民主制度需要不止一种让人民追究权力责任的方式。抗议是一项基本的民主权利。当制度受到威胁时，公众集会表明人民不会默默接受权利遭到侵蚀。但不能把全部问责重担都压在抗议上。美国中期选举之所以重要，是因为它们让公民在政府仍在任时获得定期且具有实质影响的机会来评判政府。它不只是日历上的一个日期，而是一项关于公众何时能够发言的宪政选择。韩国定期举行选举，可以充当期中检验，却没有确定的总统任期中期选举。由于总统任期是单一且不可连任的5年，而国民议会任期为4年，大选会在每届总统任期的不同时间举行。2024年4月，也就是尹锡悦任期约两年时，选民以压倒性优势把胜利交给反对派，这是一场除了名义之外各方面都算得上期中否定的选举。在李在明总统领导下，下一次大选要到2028年4月才会举行，届时他的任期已过去三年。今年6月的选举让选民得以提前评估李在明政府，但距离他就任仅一年，而且主要由地方候选人和地方议题塑造，即便国家政治占据重要位置。韩国的制衡机制确实存在，但其时机取决于日历上的算术。李在明一直主张修宪，引入美国式4年总统制，并允许连任一个任期，认为这将使政府能够接受“中期评估”。可连任的任期会让选民有机会在下一次总统选举中批准或否决总统。但那次选举将在任期结束时举行，而不是在任期中途举行。若要建立确定的期中制衡，韩国还需要另行安排一次选举——最有可能的是国民议会选举——在总统任期内的某个明确时间举行。这些变化结合起来可以加强问责。寻求连任的在任总统必须再次赢得选民的认可，而任期中定期举行的选举会让公众更早获得奖励或批评政府的机会。这可能促使总统更加关注政策对民众的影响，也会为公民提供一个和平且可预期的发泄不满渠道。这里也存在现实风险。更频繁的全国竞选活动可能加剧两极分化、助长短期决策，并使政府几乎永久处于选举状态。地方选举也可能变得更加受全国政治斗争支配。宪法改革同样不是技术性修补方案。它需要国民议会至少三分之二多数通过，并经全国公投批准，同时还需要公众就新的选举时间安排形成持久共识。韩国不必照搬美国制度，也能从其内在理念中汲取教训：人民不应非得等到总统任期结束才有机会作出裁决。抗议、法院、国民议会和选举各自发挥不同作用。设计良好的期中选举可以增加一项民主制衡，但仅靠任何日历安排都无法保证问责。韩国近期的历史恰好说明了这一点。2024年，选民对尹锡悦作出了明确的期中裁决。8个月后，他宣布在一个由反对派掌控的国民议会面前实施戒严。本周，就连从未承认自己2020年败选的特朗普也表示将接受中期选举结果。任何期中选举的价值，不仅取决于它是否给公民提供真正的选择，也取决于政治领导人是否接受结果。Min Seong-jae（smin@pace.edu）是纽约佩斯大学传播与媒体研究教授。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Korean chipmaker SK hynix Inc. is preparing to expand its U.S. workforce, its parent company said Monday, in what appears to be a move to strengthen ties with major U.S. clients, including Nvidia Corp. SK hynix plans to make additional executive appointments and reorganize its U.S. operations around Dec. 3, according to SK Group. The planned changes follow a recent executive reshuffle at SK Group, a Korean conglomerate with businesses spanning semiconductors, construction and other sectors. SK hynix had created a new executive-level post overseeing its U.S. operations and appointed Ahn Hyun, its president in charge of development, to the position. Ahn has led the development of artificial intelligence (AI) memory products, including high bandwidth memory (HBM) at SK hynix. The appointment marks a shift in the company's approach to managing its U.S. operations, which have traditionally been headed by executives with sales and marketing backgrounds. Industry sources said the move reflects changes in how HBM contracts are secured as memory chipmakers increasingly work with customers from the early stages of product development to tailor chips to their AI infrastructure. "Companies can no longer maintain their competitiveness without working closely with customers, starting from the R&D stage," an industry official said, requesting anonymity

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Leaders of the main opposition People Power Party (PPP) gathered outside Cheong Wa Dae on Monday to protest the recent passage of a bill calling for a special counsel investigation into alleged fabricated indictments targeting President Lee Jae Myung and others. The PPP leadership held a Supreme Council meeting outside the presidential office, after the ruling Democratic Party of Korea railroaded the bill through a plenary session of the National Assembly on Friday. The legislation calls for appointing an independent counsel to investigate suspicions the prosecution under former President Yoon Suk Yeol fabricated evidence or induced false testimonies to build cases against then opposition leader Lee and others. The PPP has denounced the effort as a pretext to cancel all of Lee's indictments, as his trials have been suspended under an article of the Constitution that exempts a sitting president from criminal prosecution except in cases of insurrection or treason. Lee faces charges of involvement in corrupt development schemes, illegal remittances to North Korea, and the misuse of a government charge card, stemming from his time as mayor of Seongnam or governor of Gyeonggi Province. "Lee Jae Myung's 'prison break bill' has passed the National Assembly and arrived at Cheong Wa Dae," PPP leader Jang Dong-hyeok said during the meeting, suggesting it would be approved at Tuesday's Cabinet meeting. "The key to freeing prisoner Lee Jae Myung has been placed in prisoner Lee Jae Myung's hands." Jang warned of judgment from the people should the bill be approved, including through possible impeachment. The PPP's resistance to the bill has taken various forms, with a rally held Friday outside the National Assembly and a massive outdoor rally staged near Gyeongbok Palace in central Seoul on Saturday. A relay of one-person protests outside Cheong Wa Dae has been scheduled for Monday. Rep. Jeong Jeom-sig, the party's floor leader, started it off as the first participant. On Tuesday, the party has vowed to hold a general meeting of lawmakers outside the presidential office

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 韩国最大的健康美容零售连锁店CJ Olive Young周一表示，将在2027年上半年之前于加利福尼亚州再开设5家门店，使其在美国的门店总数达到7家。Olive Young表示，其门店还向顾客介绍韩国常见的产品，例如防晒棒、通过海绵 dispensing 防晒霜的气垫粉饼，以及预先浸有爽肤水化妆水的化妆棉。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: CJ Olive Young, Korea’s largest health and beauty store chain, will open five more stores in California by the first half of 2027, bringing its U.S. total to seven, the company said Monday. The retailer opened its first U.S. store in Pasadena in May and a second at Westfield Century City in Los Angeles in June. Four of the new stores will be in the greater Los Angeles area: Spectrum Center, a lifestyle shopping center in Irvine; Del Amo Fashion Center in the South Bay area; Bloom on 3rd, a shopping complex near the Farmers Market in central Los Angeles; and Brea Mall in Orange County. The fifth will open at Fashion Valley in San Diego, its first outside the Los Angeles area. Opening dates for each store have not been set. Three of the sites — Del Amo Fashion Center, Brea Mall and Fashion Valley — are operated by Simon Property Group, a major U.S. mall owner. The company said the expansion will help small and independent Korean cosmetics brands, collectively known as K-beauty, reach American consumers without their own distribution networks. Olive Young said its stores also introduce shoppers to product types common in Korea, such as sunscreen sticks, cushion compacts that dispense sunscreen through a sponge, and toner pads, which are cotton pads presoaked in skin toner. Its in-store Skin Scan service, which analyzes a customer’s skin condition and recommends products, had been used by about 27,000 customers as of late October, roughly five months after the first store opened. “Olive Young’s U.S. stores serve as a bridge that helps emerging brands settle into the mainstream market,” an Olive Young official said. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 韩国最大的健康美容连锁店 CJ Olive Young 周一表示，公司将在2027年上半年之前于加利福尼亚州再开设五家门店，使其在美国的门店总数达到七家。该零售商于5月在帕萨迪纳开设了首家美国门店，6月在洛杉矶的 Westfield Century City 开设了第二家门店。新增门店中有四家将位于洛杉矶大都会地区：位于尔湾的生活方式购物中心 Spectrum Center；位于南湾地区的 Del Amo Fashion Center；位于洛杉矶市中心 Farmers Market 附近的购物综合体 Bloom on 3rd；以及位于橙县的 Brea Mall。第五家门店将开设在圣迭戈的 Fashion Valley，这是该品牌在洛杉矶地区以外开设的首家门店。各门店的具体开业日期尚未确定。三个选址——Del Amo Fashion Center、Brea Mall 和 Fashion Valley——均由美国大型商场运营商 Simon Property Group 运营。该公司表示，此次扩张将帮助统称为 K-beauty 的中小型独立韩国化妆品品牌，在无需自建分销网络的情况下触达美国消费者。Olive Young 表示，其门店还让顾客接触到在韩国较为常见的产品，例如防晒棒、借助海绵 dispensing 防晒产品的气垫粉饼，以及浸有化妆水的化妆棉。Olive Young 的店内肌肤检测服务可分析顾客的肌肤状况并推荐产品；截至10月下旬，该服务已为约27,000名顾客使用，而这距离首家门店开业仅约五个月。Olive Young 一名官员表示：“Olive Young 的美国门店充当一座桥梁，帮助新兴品牌融入主流市场。”本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由 The Korea Times 编辑

https://www.myjoyonline.com/huayou-seeki.summary_zh: 中国浙江华友钴业寻求收购加纳Ewoyaa锂矿开发商Atlantic Lithium，目前在刚果民主共和国受到审查，原因是其一家子公司污染给周边社区造成影响，却迟迟未支付赔偿。与此同时，华友钴业正在推进对加纳拟建的首座锂矿的投资。该公司已就收购Elevra Lithium在Ewoyaa项目及加纳资产组合中的权利和权益达成协议。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/huayou-seeki.body: Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt, the Chinese company seeking to acquire Atlantic Lithium, the developer of Ghana’s Ewoyaa lithium mine, is facing scrutiny in the Democratic Republic of Congo over delayed compensation to communities affected by pollution from one of its subsidiaries. Congo’s mines ministry said on November 6, 2026 that Congo Dongfang International Mining (CDM) remains obliged to pay $6 million to affected communities, despite financial difficulties and a suspension of its operations, Reuters reported . The development comes as Huayou advances its investment in Ghana’s proposed first lithium mine. Atlantic Lithium shareholders are scheduled to vote on the proposed takeover on December 14, following court approval. The Congo case concerns an industrial wastewater spill at CDM’s Lubumbashi operation in November 2025. According to the Congolese ministry, a basin intended to retain water had been used to store acidic solutions. The incident affected surrounding communities and prompted authorities to suspend the company’s operations for three months. Authorities subsequently required CDM to provide $2 million each to Kasapa, Kamatete and Kamisepe. A separate $6.6 million penalty was imposed for payment to the state treasury. However, implementation of the community compensation programme has been delayed. The ministry attributed the delays partly to financial difficulties cited by CDM, which recently announced that it had halted its activities. “Financial difficulties or the suspension of operations do not exempt the operator from its obligations toward affected populations,” the ministry said. For Ghana, the development draws attention to the environmental and community obligations of the group moving into Ewoyaa. Huayou’s involvement in the project is already progressing independently of its proposed acquisition of Atlantic Lithium. The company has completed an agreement to acquire Elevra Lithium’s rights and interests in the Ewoyaa project and Ghana portfolio. The proposed acquisition of Atlantic Lithium remains a separate transaction, subject to shareholder approval, regulatory approvals from Ghana’s Securities and Exchange Commission and the Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources, alignment with the Minerals Income Investment Fund, and the fulfilment of the remaining conditions. The Congo incident does not establish that similar problems will arise at Ewoyaa. It does, however, provide a record against which Ghanaian regulators and affected communities can examine the proposed investor’s environmental safeguards and arrangements for compensation. The issue extends beyond whether a company can finance a mine. It is also about whether its obligations to affected communities can be enforced when financial difficulties force it to suspend operations
https://www.myjoyonline.com/huayou-seeki.title_zh: 华友钴业寻求控制加纳Ewoyaa锂矿之际，因刚果补偿款延迟而受到审查
https://www.myjoyonline.com/huayou-seeki.body_zh: 寻求收购加纳Ewoyaa锂矿开发商Atlantic Lithium的中国公司Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt，正因旗下子公司污染影响社区后的赔偿支付延迟，在刚果民主共和国受到审查。据Reuters报道，刚果矿业部于2026年11月6日表示，尽管面临财务困难且已暂停运营，Congo Dongfang International Mining（CDM）仍有义务向受影响的社区支付600万美元。与此同时，Huayou正推进其对加纳拟建首座锂矿的投资。经法院批准后，Atlantic Lithium股东定于12月14日就拟议收购进行表决。刚果此案涉及CDM位于Lubumbashi的业务于2025年11月发生的工业废水泄漏事故。据刚果方面称，该公司的水坝原本用于蓄水，却被用来储存酸性溶液。事故影响了周边社区，并促使当局暂停该公司运营三个月。当局随后要求CDM分别向Kasapa、Kamatete和Kamisepe提供200万美元。此外，公司还被处以660万美元罚款，须向国库支付。然而，社区赔偿计划的执行一直延迟。该部将部分延误归因于CDM所称的财务困难；该公司最近宣布已停止业务。该部表示：“财务困难或暂停运营并不能免除运营方对受影响居民的义务。”对加纳而言，此事凸显Huayou进入Ewoyaa项目后所承担的环境和社区义务。即使不收购Atlantic Lithium，Huayou参与该项目的相关工作也已在推进。该公司已就收购Elevra Lithium在Ewoyaa项目及加纳资产组合中的权利和权益签署协议。拟议收购Atlantic Lithium仍是一项单独交易，须获得股东批准、加纳Securities and Exchange Commission及Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources的监管批准，符合Minerals Income Investment Fund的要求，并满足其余条件。刚果事件并不能证明Ewoyaa也会出现类似问题，但它留下了一份记录，供加纳监管机构和受影响社区据以审查拟议投资者的环保保障措施及赔偿安排。问题不仅在于一家公司能否为矿山融资，也在于当财务困难迫使其暂停运营时，其对受影响社区承担的义务能否得到强制执行

莫斯科对内比都的无人机战争支持正在升级。在掸邦和勃固地区，俄罗斯人出现在前线，执行训练任务，并不时提供作战支持。缅甸军方采用了低成本自杀式无人机，与俄罗斯在乌克兰测试过的无人机相似。

强大的阿拉干军已与其附属团体采取类似做法，卡伦尼邦抵抗力量希望在4月前建立一支统一军队。在掸邦南部，它已将众多地方武装力量集结在“阿尔法”这一单一指挥体系下。

在缅甸的欧洲雇佣兵（上）/下｜2023年10月27日，12名外国人在缅甸北部劳开附近被一个民族 rebel 组织俘获。这些人大多数是法国军团退役军人，但其中两人仍在服役。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/white-house-.body: US President Donald Trump's administration has vowed not to change course on its mass deportation plans after last week's midterm elections defeat. "This administration will not slow down its efforts to arrest and deport criminal illegal aliens who terrorise our communities," the White House said in a statement to the BBC. Trump's promotion on Friday of immigration hawk Stephen Miller to White House chief of staff had signalled no climbdown from the administration on border security. Exit polls indicate immigration was the third most important issue for midterm voters, after the economy and the state of democracy. In historically conservative states like Texas, a swing of Latino voters towards Democrats helped seal the party's landslide congressional majorities. But multiple US officials sources told the BBC's US partner CBS that the administration had put the midterm losses down to concerns about the economy, affordability and the war with Iran, rather than its immigration crackdown. The White House maintained on Sunday there would be no change of direction. "There has never been a President stronger on immigration enforcement than President Trump," said White House spokeswoman Lauren Bis. The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) also said it would forge ahead. "ICE is NOT backing away or slowing down," a DHS spokesperson told CBS. Following Tuesday's results, Vice-President JD Vance had appeared receptive to adjusting their immigration strategy. "I'm open to the idea that we should change enforcement - by focusing more on businesses that hire illegal labour, for instance," Vance wrote in a lengthy online post reflecting on the results. But the White House's posture appears to have hardened after Trump promoted Stephen Miller to chief of staff on Friday. Miller is widely seen as the architect of the administration's hardline immigration policy during the first and second Trump presidencies. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) sources told CBS that in recent weeks officials have been instructed to aim for about 2,700 arrests of illegal immigrants per day, an increase from an earlier 2,000 daily arrest target. Enforcement sweeps this year spurred anti-ICE demonstrations in cities including Chicago, Minneapolis and Los Angeles. In Minneapolis, two US protesters, Renee Good and Alex Pretti, were fatally shot by immigration agents
https://www.myjoyonline.com/white-house-.title_zh: 白宫誓言在中期选举失利后继续加强移民执法
https://www.myjoyonline.com/white-house-.body_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的政府上周中期选举失利后，誓言不会改变其大规模驱逐计划。白宫在向英国广播公司（BBC）发表的声明中表示：“本届政府不会放缓逮捕和驱逐那些恐吓我们社区的犯罪非法移民的努力。”特朗普周五提拔移民强硬派人士斯蒂芬·米勒出任白宫幕僚长，这表明该政府在边境安全政策上不会退缩。各州出口民调显示，移民问题是中期选举选民最看重的第三大问题，仅次于经济和民主状况。在得克萨斯州等历来保守的州，拉丁裔选民转向民主党，帮助该党锁定国会的压倒性多数席位。然而，多名美国官员向英国广播公司的美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司（CBS）表示，政府将中期选举失利归咎于人们对经济、生活成本以及与伊朗战争的担忧，而非其收紧移民政策。白宫周日照例表示不会改变方向。白宫发言人劳伦·比斯说：“在移民执法方面，从来没有哪位总统比特朗普总统更坚定。”国土安全部（DHS）也表示将继续推进工作。一名国土安全部发言人对哥伦比亚广播公司说：“移民与海关执法局（ICE）绝不会后退或放慢行动。”周二投票结果公布后，副总统JD·万斯似乎愿意调整移民战略。万斯在一篇反思选举结果的长篇网络帖子中写道：“我愿意考虑我们是否应调整执法重点，例如更多地关注雇用非法劳工的企业。”但特朗普周五提拔斯蒂芬·米勒出任幕僚长后，白宫的立场似乎变得更加强硬。widely被视为特朗普第一和第二任总统任内强硬移民政策策划者的米勒，也是这一政策的设计者。移民与海关执法局（ICE）消息人士对哥伦比亚广播公司表示，近几周官员接到指示，每天目标是逮捕约2,700名非法移民，高于此前每日逮捕2,000人的目标。今年开展的执法突袭行动在芝加哥、明尼阿波利斯和洛杉矶等城市引发了反对移民与海关执法局的示威。在明尼阿波利斯，两名美国示威者蕾妮·古德和亚历克斯·普雷蒂被移民执法人员开枪致命打死

https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.summary: US tech giant Nvidia has opened an independent investigation following reports that its CEO, Jensen Huang, had a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.summary_zh: 美国科技巨头英伟达启动独立调查。此前有报道称，该公司首席执行官黄仁勋与一名疑似中国间谍有交往。《纽约时报》报道，美国情报官员认为，与黄仁勋关系密切的中国女商人黄艾丽丝是北京派来的间谍。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.body: US tech giant Nvidia has opened an independent investigation following reports that its CEO, Jensen Huang, had a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. The company, one of the world's most valuable, said its board had no reason to believe its secrets or national security were compromised, adding that the CEO was committed to continuing to lead the company. Separately, Jensen Huang admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report. Jensen Huang said he took "full responsibility" for what he did, adding that he had fallen short of his responsibilities to Nvidia's employees, board and shareholders. Nvidia is one of the world's largest companies and is seen as central to making the hardware for emerging AI technologies. Its CEO said: "I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry." His statement continued: "Regarding the national security concerns raised in news reports, Nvidia's Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation. I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. "I love our country and our company. I am committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America's national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American." A separate statement issued by Nvidia's board of directors said it would begin an investigation in "light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort". It continued: "The Board prioritises US national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of Nvidia and its shareholders. Alice Huang, who is of no relation to Jensen Huang, is linked to Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed. The company told the New York Times last month its current leadership took the allegations seriously and had appointed external legal advisers to conduct an internal investigation. Nvidia is a central player in AI infrastructure, providing chips to leading AI model developers including OpenAI and Meta. The microchip manufacturer is worth some $4.5 trillion, making it one of the most valuable companies ever. China previously rejected allegations of an espionage operation targeting Nvidia's chief, calling the claims "groundless speculation" . US intelligence agencies monitored Alice Huang and concluded she was acting on behalf of the Chinese government, according to unnamed sources cited by The New York Times. Surveillance reportedly revealed communications between Alice Huang and an American citizen, who was subsequently identified as Jensen Huang through a process known as "unmasking". It remains unclear what information Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly passed to Beijing, how valuable it was, or when she is believed to have begun gathering intelligence. Alice Huang did not respond to the paper's request for comment. Last week, members of Congress wrote to Jensen Huang, asking him to appear before them in the light of the reported relationship. Three House Republican committee leaders asked the CEO to appear later in the month, to talk about Nvidia's "security protocols against foreign adversary espionage" given his reported relation Alice Huang. "Recent reports raise significant national security concerns regarding the PRC's [China's] access to sensitive US technology and information. "The issue of PRC infiltration and access to cutting-edge US technology is core to the investigative work of our three committees this Congress," the letter said. Nvidia's AI chips have been a major focus of the rivalry between the US and China, and Washington has previously imposed controls on where its advanced products can be sold. The H200, Nvidia's second most advanced semiconductor, had previously been restricted by Washington over concerns that it would give China's technology industry an edge over the US. In January, the Trump administration said it would allow the company to sell its H200 chips to Chinese customers under certain conditions
https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.title_zh: Nvidia就首席执行官涉嫌与疑似中国间谍有染展开调查
https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.body_zh:
美国科技巨头英伟达启动了一项独立调查。此前有报道称，该公司的首席执行官黄仁勋与一名疑似中国间谍存在关系。英伟达是全球市值最高的企业之一。公司表示，董事会没有理由相信公司的机密或国家安全受到损害，并补充称，首席执行官致力于继续领导公司。

与此同时，黄仁勋承认自己曾对妻子“不忠”，并为伤害妻子和孩子道歉。据《纽约时报》报道，美国情报官员认为，与黄仁勋关系密切的中国女商人黄爱丽是为北京效力的间谍。黄仁勋表示，他对自己所做的事承担“全部责任”，并称自己没有尽到对英伟达员工、董事会和股东的责任。他说：“我背叛了妻子。我所做的事伤害了妻子和孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”

他的声明接着说：“关于新闻报道提出的国家安全问题，英伟达董事会已启动独立调查。我支持这项调查，并将全力配合。

“我热爱我们的国家和公司。我致力于保护英伟达，并支持美国的国家安全。我很自豪，也很感激自己是一名美国人。”

英伟达董事会另行发表声明称，鉴于近期有报道称创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋成为外国情报行动的目标，董事会将展开调查。声明称：“董事会将美国国家和经济安全置于首位，这是压倒英伟达及其股东利益的大事。黄爱丽与黄仁勋没有亲属关系，她与总部位于新加坡的数据中心企业Megaspeed有关联。该公司上月告诉《纽约时报》，现任管理层认真对待相关指控，并已聘请外部法律顾问开展内部调查。

英伟达是人工智能基础设施领域的核心企业，向包括OpenAI和Meta在内的领先人工智能模型开发商提供芯片。这家微芯片制造商市值约4.5万亿美元，成为有史以来市值最高的公司之一。中国此前驳斥了针对英伟达首席执行官的间谍行动指控，称这些说法是“毫无根据的猜测”。

《纽约时报》援引未具名消息人士称，美国情报机构监视黄爱丽后得出结论，认为她代表中国政府行事。据报道，监视记录显示黄爱丽与一名美国公民有过通信，这名公民随后通过名为“身份揭露”的程序被确认为黄仁勋。目前尚不清楚黄爱丽——也被称为黄乐——据称向北京传递了什么信息、这些信息有多大价值，以及人们认为她从何时开始收集情报。黄爱丽没有回应该报置评请求。

上周，国会议员致函黄仁勋，要求他就这段被曝光的关系出席作证。众议院三个共和党的委员会领导人要求这位首席执行官于本月晚些时候出席，讨论英伟达“防范外国对手间谍活动的安全规程”，理由是他与黄爱丽之间被曝存在关系。信中写道：“近期报道引发了对中国获取美国敏感技术和信息这一重大国家安全问题的关注。中国渗透并获取美国尖端技术，是我们本届国会三个委员会调查工作的核心。”

英伟达的人工智能芯片一直是中美竞争的一个主要焦点，华盛顿此前也对该公司先进产品的销售地区实施限制。英伟达最先进的半导体产品H200此前受到华盛顿限制，原因是外界担心它会令中国科技产业获得相对于美国的优势。今年1月，特朗普政府表示，将在满足特定条件的情况下允许该公司向中国客户出售H200芯片

https://leadership.ng/adc-will-be-on-bal.summary: The Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Development, Festus Keyamo, has said the African Democratic Congress (ADC) will participate in the 2027 general elections, but warned that candidates produced by the David Mark-led faction, including former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar, may not appear on the ballot. Keyamo said the fate of the candidates would depend on the final determination of the party’s leadership dispute by the Supreme Court.
https://leadership.ng/adc-will-be-on-bal.summary_zh: 航空与航天发展部长费斯图斯·凯亚莫表示，非洲民主大会（ADC）将参加2027年大选，但警告由戴维·马克派系推举的候选人，包括前副总统阿提库·阿布巴卡尔，可能不会出现在选票上。凯亚莫表示，这些候选人的命运将取决于最高法院对该党领导权争端作出的最终裁决。
https://leadership.ng/adc-will-be-on-bal.body: The Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Development, Festus Keyamo, has said the African Democratic Congress (ADC) will participate in the 2027 general elections, but warned that candidates produced by the David Mark-led faction, including former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar, may not appear on the ballot. Keyamo said the fate of the candidates would depend on the final determination of the party’s leadership dispute by the Supreme Court. The minister stated this in a post on his verified X handle on Sunday, following concerns that a recent Federal High Court judgment against the Mark-led leadership could prevent the opposition party from fielding candidates in the elections. The Federal High Court in Abuja had on Thursday nullified the Mark-led National Working Committee and invalidated decisions taken by the faction, including the presidential primary that produced Atiku as the ADC’s candidate for the 2027 election. The judgment followed a suit filed by former ADC Deputy National Chairman (North-East), Nafiu Gombe, in which he challenged the process through which Mark and other members of the caretaker committee assumed control of the party. Gombe argued that following the resignation of former National Chairman, Ralph Nwosu, he was constitutionally entitled to take over the party’s leadership. Reacting to the ruling, Keyamo dismissed suggestions that it meant the ADC would be excluded from the 2027 elections. “For the education of the public, those raising false alarm that the court judgment on ADC means the party will not be on the ballot are spreading misinformation. “The ADC will be on the ballot. It is the David Mark faction of candidates, including Atiku Abubakar, that may not be on the ballot, depending on the final judgment of the Supreme Court,” he said. The minister also questioned why the judgment was being portrayed as an attempt to prevent the opposition party from participating in the elections. He argued that candidates who emerged through the party’s original leadership structure should not be denied their political rights because of the dispute. “Therefore, the question we must ask those raising hell is: are those Nigerians who successfully won their primaries under the faction of the original owners of the ADC lesser humans or lesser Nigerians than David Mark and Atiku Abubakar?” he asked. Meanwhile, the Mark-led faction has rejected the judgment and vowed to challenge it in court. Atiku and the party have also indicated plans to appeal the ruling. The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) has said it would not take a position on the dispute until it obtains and studies the certified true copy of the judgment. The outcome of the pending appeals is expected to determine which faction has the legal authority to control the ADC and nominate candidates for the 2027 general elections. We’ve got the edge.
